original: aprameyo'niyojyaśca ityādyuktaprakāreṇa sāpekṣatvādivyudāsāya līlā śabdaḥ | janayitṛtvādyanuktvā janmādyuktirupādānābhiprāyā; bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti iti hi śrutiḥ | līlā śabdena nimittatvaṃ dyotitam | avāptasamastakāmasya vyāpārānupapatiṃta pariharatānena līlāśabdena dvitīyalakṣaṇārthaśca sūcitaḥ | atha dvitīyadvikārthaṃ saṃkṣipati - vinateti |
analyzed: aprameyaḥ niyojyaḥ ca ityādi ukta prakāreṇa sāpekṣa tva ādi vyudāsāya līlā śabdaḥ janayitṛ tva ādi an uktvā janma ādi uktiḥ upādāna abhiprāyā bahu syām prajāyeya iti iti hi śrutiḥ līlā śabdena nimitta tvam dyotitam avāpta samasta kāmasya pariharatā anena līlā śabdena dvitīya lakṣaṇa arthaḥ ca sūcitaḥ atha dvitīya dvika artham saṃkṣipati vinatā iti

original: vinatarakṣāpa dābhyāṃ tṛtīyacaturthalakṣaṇārthau sūcitau | viśeṣeṇa natāḥ prahvībhūtāḥ upāsakāḥ; tadvaividhyaṃ taduparyapi bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt ityādivakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa | bhūtāḥ; bhagavajjñānena labdhasattākāḥ iti bhāvaḥ; asti brahmeti cedveda, santamenaṃ tato viduriti iti śruteḥ | vinatabhūtasaṃbandhī vrāto vinatabhūtavrātaḥ |
analyzed: vinata rakṣāpa dābhyām tṛtīya caturtha lakṣaṇa arthau sūcitau viśeṣeṇa natāḥ prahvībhūtāḥ upāsakāḥ tad vaividhyam tad upari api bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt ityādi vakṣyamāṇa prakāreṇa bhūtāḥ bhagavat jñānena labdha sattākāḥ iti bhāvaḥ asti brahma iti ced veda santam enam tatas viduḥ iti iti śruteḥ vinata bhūta saṃbandhī vrātaḥ vinatabhūtavrātaḥ

original: vrāta śabdena āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ paśurmanuṣyaḥ pakṣī vā ityādyartho'bhipretaḥ | rakṣā iṣṭaprāpaṇāniṣṭanivāraṇalakṣaṇā | eka śabdaḥ prādhānyaparaḥ apyahaṃ jīvitaṃ jahyām kāmamātmānaṃ bhāryāṃputraṃ voparundhyānna tveva dāsakarmakaram iti hyuktam | sā pradhānā dīkṣā yasya tattathoktam | dīkṣāśabdenāvarjanīyatvaṃ garbhitam;
analyzed: vrāta śabdena āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ paśuḥ manuṣyaḥ pakṣī vā ityādi arthaḥ abhipretaḥ rakṣā iṣṭa prāpaṇa aniṣṭa nivāraṇa lakṣaṇā eka śabdaḥ prādhānya paraḥ api aham jīvitam jahyām kāmam ātmānam bhāryām putram vā uparundhyāt na tu eva dāsa karmakaram iti hi uktam sā pradhānā dīkṣā yasya tat tathā uktam dīkṣā śabdena avarjanīya tvam garbhitam

original: etadvrataṃ mama iti hi taduktiḥ |

original: atha śāstropoddhātacatuḥsūtryarthamāha - śrutīti | brahmaṇo mānaśūnyatvānyamānakatvavyudāsena śāstrārambhaṇīyatā hi tadarthaḥ | śruti śabdaḥ pramāṇavailakṣaṇyaṃ dyotayati; śrūyate nityamiti hi śrutiḥ | śiraḥ śabdenānanyaparabhāgoktiḥ | vidīptiḥ viśeṣeṇa dīptiḥ;
analyzed: atha śāstra upoddhāta catuḥsūtrī artham āha śruti iti brahmaṇaḥ māna śūnyatva anya mānakatva vyudāsena śāstra ārambhaṇīyatā hi tad arthaḥ śruti śabdaḥ pramāṇa vailakṣaṇyam dyotayati śrūyate nityam iti hi śrutiḥ śiraḥ śabdena ananya parabhāga uktiḥ vidīptiḥ viśeṣeṇa dīptiḥ

original: agnyādirūpeṇakarmārādhyatāyā api vedāntāvagatatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ svato'nantapuruṣārthatvaṃ cābhipretya viśeṣeṇa dīptatvamuktam | brahmaṇīti sāmānyaśabdaḥ | śrīnivāsa iti viśeṣaśabdaḥ | atra chāgo vā mantravarṇāt iti nyāyo'bhipretaḥ | śrīnivāsa śabdena rūḍhito'vayavataśca trimūrtyaikyasāmyottīrṇatvādivyudāso nityavibhūtiyogaśca phalitaḥ |
analyzed: agni ādi rūpeṇa karma ārādhyatāyāḥ api vedānta avagata tvam brahmaṇaḥ svatas ananta puruṣa artha tvam ca abhipretya viśeṣeṇa dīpta tvam uktam brahmaṇi iti sāmānya śabdaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ iti viśeṣa śabdaḥ atra chāgaḥ vā mantra varṇāt iti nyāya ubhipretaḥ śrīnivāsa śabdena rūḍhitaḥ vayavataḥ ca trimūrti aikya sāmya uttīrṇa tva ādi vyudāsaḥ nitya vibhūti yogaḥ ca phalitaḥ

original: parasminniti paramataḥ setūnmāna ityatra nirṇītaṃ prāpyatvaṃ vivakṣitam | athopāyopeyātmake pratipādye vinatapadasūcitamupāyāṃśaṃ viśinaṣṭi - śemuṣī bhaktirūpeti | atrāpi chāgapaśunyāyo'bhipretaḥ | padadvayena dhīkarmasamuccayavākyārthajñānamātropāyatvavyudāsaḥ | svanikarṣābhiprāyeṇāha - mameti |

original: bhavatu - phalāntarādetadviṣayopāyaḥ svādutama iti bhāvaḥ |

original: evaṃ paramaviṣayo darśitaḥ | prayojanaṃ cātrātisaṃkṣiptam | atha svagranthasyāvāntaraviṣayaṃ svavyākhyeyasya vyākhyeyāntarādvaiṣamyaṃ ca vadan saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstraprayojanaṃ ca viśadīkurvan vyākhyānāntarebhyaḥ svagranthasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ ca darśayannarthāt gurūpāsanarūpaṃ maṅgalamācarati - pārāśaryeti |
analyzed: evam parama viṣayaḥ darśitaḥ prayojanam ca atra ati saṃkṣiptam atha sva granthasya avāntara viṣayam sva vyākhyeyasya vyākhyeya antarāt vaiṣamyam ca vadan saṃkṣiptam śāstra prayojanam ca viśadīkurvan vyākhyāna antarebhyaḥ sva granthasya vailakṣaṇyam ca darśayan arthāt guru upāsana rūpam maṅgalam ācarati pārāśarya iti

analyzed: pārāśarya vacaḥ sudhām upaniṣad dugdha abdhi madhya uddhṛtām saṃsāra agni vidīpana vyapagata prāṇa ātma sañjīvanīm

original: pūrvācāryasurakṣitāṃ bahumativyāghātadūrasthitām ānītāṃ tu nijākṣaraiḥ sumanaso bhaumāḥ pibantvanvaham ||
analyzed: pūrva ācārya su rakṣitām bahu mati vyāghāta dūra sthitām ānītām tu nija akṣaraiḥ sumanasaḥ bhaumāḥ pibantu anvaham

original: vyāsasyaiva bādarāyaṇatvaṃ śrutisiddham | janmataḥ prakarṣaṃ ca sūcayati pārāśaryaśabdena | vacaḥ - śabdo'rthaparyantaḥ, vedavit ityatra vedaśabdavat | vacasaḥ sudhāmiti nirvāhe rūpakaprakaraṇānaucityaṃ sudhāśabdāmukhyatvaṃ ca | amṛtatvahetutvāt sudhātvarūpaṇam | pūrvabhāgādapyavyavadhānena brahmapratipādanarūpā setyabhiprāya upaniṣa cchabdaḥ |
analyzed: vyāsasya eva bādarāyaṇa tvam śruti siddham janmataḥ prakarṣam ca sūcayati pārāśarya śabdena vacaḥ śabda ūrtha paryantaḥ veda vid iti atra veda śabda vat vacasaḥ sudhām iti nirvāhe rūpaka prakaraṇa anaucityam sudhā śabda amukhya tvam ca amṛta tva hetutvāt sudhā tva rūpaṇam pūrva bhāgāt api avyavadhānena brahma pratipādana rūpā sā iti abhiprāyaḥ upaniṣad śabdaḥ

original: upaniṣadāṃ vedasāratvābhiprāyo dugdhaśabdaḥ; yathā āraṇkaṃ ca vedebhya oṣadhībhyo yathāmṛtam iti | abdhi śabda ānantyaparaḥ | madhya śabdena sarvaśrutimukhyatvamabhipretam, madhyasya sarvapradeśānuguṇyāt | anena svavyākhyeyasya pramāṇamūlatā avāntaraviṣayaśca darśitau |
analyzed: upaniṣadām veda sāra tva abhiprāyaḥ dugdha śabdaḥ yathā āraṇkam ca vedebhyaḥ oṣadhībhyaḥ yathā amṛtam iti abdhi śabdaḥ ānantya paraḥ madhya śabdena sarva śruti mukhya tvam abhipretam madhyasya sarva pradeśa ānuguṇyāt anena sva vyākhyeyasya pramāṇa mūla tā avāntara viṣayaḥ ca darśitau

original: uddhṛtaśabdenātinimnadeśanimagnodgrahaṇamabhidadhatā niḥśeṣārthagrahaṇaṃ sūcitam | parama prayojanamāha - saṃsāreti | saṃsārasyāgnitvaṃ tāpatrayātmakatayā | tatrāpyavāntarabhedaṃ vidyālabdheḥ pūrvaṃ kadācidapyanirvāpyatvaṃ vaividhyamanuparatatvaṃ ca dyotayati vidīpana śabdaḥ |
analyzed: uddhṛta śabdena ati nimna deśa nimagna udgrahaṇam abhidadhatā niḥśeṣa artha grahaṇam sūcitam prayojanam āha saṃsāra iti saṃsārasya agni tvam tāpa traya ātmaka tayā tatra api avāntarabhedam vidyā labdheḥ pūrvam kadācid api a nirvāpya tvam vaividhyam anuparata tvam ca dyotayati vidīpana śabdaḥ

original: anādikālaṃ bahumukhaśravaṇādiṣvanyatamaprakāreṇālabdhaparamātmāno vyapagataprāṇāḥ | prāṇāḥ paramātmā, prāṇamevābhisaṃviśanti iti śrautaprayogāt | saṃjīvinīm iti paramamokṣahetutvaṃ vivakṣitam | svagranthasya satsaṃpradāyamūlakatāmāha - pūrveti | ārthaṃ gurūpāsanaṃ caitatkīrtanamukhenātra kṛtam | śaṃkarādivyudāsāya pūrvaśabdaḥ |
analyzed: anādi kālam bahu mukha śravaṇa ādiṣu anyatama prakāreṇa a labdha paramātmānaḥ vyapagata prāṇāḥ prāṇāḥ paramātmā prāṇam eva abhisaṃviśanti iti śrauta prayogāt saṃjīvinīm iti parama mokṣa hetutvam vivakṣitam sva granthasya sat saṃpradāya mūlaka tām āha pūrva iti ārtham guru upāsanam ca etat kīrtana mukhena atra kṛtam śaṃkara ādi vyudāsāya pūrva śabdaḥ

original: surakṣitām na paramupadeśena, granthanirmāṇenāpīti bhāvaḥ | tarhi sā kimiti na prathitetyatrāha - bahumatīti | bahūnāṃ yā matayaḥ tāsāṃ vyāghāto mitho virodhaḥ, tena dūrasthitām | na yathāvadapratipattimātram, anyathā ca pratipattirabhūditi bhāvaḥ | tuśabdaḥ svagranthavaiṣamyaparaḥ | sudhāsamākhyānuguṇyāya mamākṣarairityanuktiḥ;
analyzed: su rakṣitām na param upadeśena grantha nirmāṇena api iti bhāvaḥ tarhi sā kim iti na prathitā iti atra āha bahu mati iti bahūnām yāḥ matayaḥ tāsām vyāghātaḥ mithas virodhaḥ tena dūra sthitām na yathāvat apratipatti mātram anyathā ca pratipattiḥ abhūt iti bhāvaḥ tuśabdaḥ sva grantha vaiṣamya paraḥ sudhā samākhyā ānuguṇyāya mama akṣaraiḥ iti anuktiḥ

original: gāyatryavayavāmṛtākṣarairityarthaḥ | sumanasaḥ; sārāsāravivekādivicakṣaṇāḥ | bhaumāḥ; adhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedāḥ śrutakarmamīmāṃsā bhūlokavāsinaḥ | deśakālāntarādiṣu vṛttyādisāphalyamiti bhāvaḥ | pibantu; sudhāpānavadasya śravaṇādyapi sukharūpam ityarthaḥ | anvaham; bhogyatātiśayāt gabhīratvācca |
analyzed: gāyatrī avayava amṛta akṣaraiḥ iti arthaḥ sumanasaḥ sāra asāra viveka ādi vicakṣaṇāḥ bhaumāḥ adhīta sāṅga sa śiraska vedāḥ śruta karma mīmāṃsāḥ bhū loka vāsinaḥ deśa kāla antara ādiṣu vṛtti ādi sāphalyam iti bhāvaḥ pibantu sudhā pāna vat asya śravaṇa ādi api sukha rūpam iti arthaḥ anvaham bhogyatā atiśayāt gabhīra tvāt ca

original: bhagavaddhodhāyanakṛtāṃ vistīrṇāṃ brahmasūtravṛtiṃta pūrvācāryāḥ sañcikṣipuḥ | tanmatānusāreṇa sūtrākṣarāṇi vyākhyāsyante||1||
analyzed: bhagavat hodhāyana kṛtām vistīrṇām pūrva ācāryāḥ sañcikṣipuḥ tad mata anusāreṇa sūtra akṣarāṇi vyākhyāsyante

original: pūrvācāryagranthāḥ pravartyantām; kiṃ granthāntaranirmāṇaprayatnagauraveṇetyatrāha - bhagavaditi | pūrvācāryaśabdo'tra vivṛtaḥ | śaṅkarādibhyo'pi jñānādhikyaparo bhagava cchabdaḥ | dramiḍācāryādigrantho'tisaṃkṣiptaḥ | tanmatānusāreṇa; na tu svotprekṣayā | sūtrākṣarāṇi; prakṛti pratyayānuguṇyena; na tu yathākathaṃcidyojayitavyānīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pūrva ācārya granthāḥ pravartyantām kim grantha antara nirmāṇa prayatna gauraveṇa iti atra āha bhagavat iti pūrva ācārya śabdaḥ utra vivṛtaḥ śaṅkara ādibhyaḥ api jñāna ādhikya paraḥ bhagavat śabdaḥ dramiḍa ācārya ādi grantha uti saṃkṣiptaḥ tad mata anusāreṇa na tu sva utprekṣayā sūtra akṣarāṇi prakṛti pratyaya ānuguṇyena na tu yathā kathaṃcid yojayitavyāni iti bhāvaḥ

original: vyāṅbhyāmupasargābhyāmapekṣitavistarānapekṣitasaṃkocau vivakṣitau | vyākhyeyaṃ padam upādatte - atheti |
analyzed: vi āṅbhyām upasargābhyām apekṣita vistara an apekṣita saṃkocau vivakṣitau vyākhyeyam padam upādatte atha iti

original: athāto brahmajijñāsā || 1-1-1||

original: ananupraviṣṭāḥ śaṃ no mitraḥ ityādayaḥ | niyamāḥ; pūrvoktāḥ | arthajñānavyudāsāya mātraśabdaḥ; śabdapratipannametāvat, tatra tātparyaṃ ca paryavasyatītyarthaḥ; na hyādhānavākyamuttarakratuviniyogaparyantam, tadvaditi bhāvaḥ |

original: atha vidherakṣaragrahaṇaparyantatve svādhyāyasyārthaparatve mānābhāvādavivakṣitārthatvaṃ, vidheḥ puruṣārthaparyantatvābhāvaḥ, pravartakābhāvānmīmāṃsānārambhaṇīyatvaṃ ca syāt - iti trividhānupapattimūlāmarthadhīparyantatāṃ tannimittāṃ brahmavicārārambhaśaṅkāṃ ca vyudasya, ekavyākhyeyavyākhyānatayā śāstraikyamapi darśayati - adhyayanetyādinā |

original: svabhāvataḥ ityādinā avivakṣitārthatvaparihāraḥ | sākṣātprayojanaparyavasānaṃ tvanmate'pi na; paraṃparayā cedasmanmate'pyastītyabhiprāyeṇa prayojanavirahaṃ pariharati prayojanavadartha śabdaḥ | svargamokṣādiprayojanavanto'rthā yajñopāsanādayaḥ | pūrvaṃ śrutisvabhāvoktiḥ; paścāt tannimittāpātapratītiḥ |

original: āpātapratītisamaye'pi prayojanavattayaiva pratītisiddhyarthaṃ prayojanavato'rthā niti punaḥ kīrtanam | tatra hetuḥ - gṛhītāditi; sāṅgādhyayanagṛhītādityarthaḥ; avagamyamānān dṛṣṭvā; avagatatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā | svarūpam aṅgī; prakāraḥ aṅgam | viśeṣaḥ pūrvapakṣitarūpādvaiṣamyam |

original: vyākaraṇādivyāvṛttaṃ śāstraśarīraṃ vicāraḥ | nirṇayaḥ phalam | svayamevādhītavedatve sati puruṣatvāccetanatvādrāgata eva pravartate, na tu vidhinetyarthaḥ | anena pravartakābhāvādanārambhaḥ parihṛtaḥ | śrutau smṛtau cādhyayanaśabdasya tulyārthatayā prābalyadaurbalyakalpanamanarthakam | śrutiścāsti - vedamadhītyābhisamāvṛtya iti |
analyzed: vyākaraṇa ādi vyāvṛttam śāstra śarīram vicāraḥ nirṇayaḥ phalam svayam eva adhīta veda tve sati puruṣa tvāt cetana tvāt rāgataḥ eva pravartate na tu vidhinā iti arthaḥ anena pravartaka abhāvāt anārambhaḥ parihṛtaḥ śrutau smṛtau ca adhyayana śabdasya tulya ārtha tayā prābalya daurbalya kalpanam anarthakam śrutiḥ ca asti vedam adhītya abhisamāvṛtya iti

original: rāgaprāptasyāpi svopayogyarthārjanāderiva śravaṇasyāpi vidhiravasarapradaḥ | ktvāpratyayaḥ samānakartṛkatvapūrvakālatvaparaḥ, na tvānantaryaparaḥ | snātakasyāpi śravaṇaṃ ghaṭate, śrāvayiturivāvasarasaṃbhavāt | na ca udakāharaṇādibhiranuṣṭhānoparodhaḥ, adhyayanavidhiprayuktānāṃ tannivṛttau nivṛtteḥ | vittakhyātyādi guroḥ phalam |
analyzed: rāga prāptasya api sva upayogi artha arjana ādeḥ iva śravaṇasya api vidhiḥ avasara pradaḥ ktvāpratyayaḥ samāna kartṛkatva pūrva kālatva paraḥ na tu ānantarya paraḥ snātakasya api śravaṇam ghaṭate śrāvayituḥ iva avasara saṃbhavāt na ca udaka āharaṇa ādibhiḥ anuṣṭhāna uparodhaḥ adhyayana vidhi prayuktānām tad nivṛttau nivṛtteḥ vitta khyāti ādi guroḥ phalam

original: yāvacchravaṇasamāpti hitaiṣivacanādanuṣṭhānopapattiḥ | na ca tarhi mīmāṃsānairapekṣyam, mūlajijñāsayā svayaṃ pratipipādayiṣayā ca sāpekṣatvāt | na ca hitaiṣivākyādanuṣṭhāne'paśūdranayavirodhaḥ, na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāt ityādibhirbrāhmaṇaistasyānupadeśāt; kratuṣu japyamantrādīnāṃ traivarṇikādhikāropanayanāṅgakādhyayanasāpekṣatvācca |
analyzed: yāvacchravaṇa samāpti hita eṣi vacanāt anuṣṭhāna upapattiḥ na ca tarhi mīmāṃsā nairapekṣyam mūla jijñāsayā svayam pratipipādayiṣayā ca sāpekṣa tvāt na ca hita eṣi vākyāt anuṣṭhāna īpa śūdra naya virodhaḥ na śūdrāya matim dadyāt ityādibhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ tasya anupadeśāt kratuṣu japya mantra ādīnām traivarṇika adhikāra upanayana aṅgaka adhyayana sāpekṣa tvāt ca

original: ato rāgataḥ pravṛttyupapattiḥ | vedavākyavicārarūpaśabdena vyākhyeyaikyācchāstraikyaṃ ca siddhamityabhipretam |

original: tatra karmavidhisvarūpe nirūpite karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā ... ... tannirṇayaphalavedāntāvicārarūpaśārīrakamīmāṃsāyāmadhikaroti||
analyzed: tatra karma vidhi svarūpe nirūpite karmaṇām alpa asthira phalatvam dṛṣṭvā tad nirṇaya phala vedānta avicāra rūpa śārīraka mīmāṃsāyām adhikaroti

original: evamastu, kathaṃ paurvāparyaniyamaḥ ityatrāha - tatreti | nirūpite; karmasvarūpameva nirūpitam | āvṛttividhānādinā'lpāsthiraphalatvaṃ phalitamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā karma nirūpitam, na tvārādhyaparadevatā | tajjñāne sati hi phalānantyamiti bhāvaḥ | annavānannādo bhavati ityānuṣaṅgikaphalavyudāsāya amṛtatvarūpa śabdaḥ |
analyzed: evam astu katham paurvāparya niyamaḥ iti atra āha tatra iti nirūpite karma svarūpam eva nirūpitam āvṛtti vidhāna ādinā alpa asthira phalatvam phalitam iti bhāvaḥ yat vā karma nirūpitam na tu ārādhya para devatā tad jñāne sati hi phala ānantyam iti bhāvaḥ annavān anna ādaḥ bhavati iti ānuṣaṅgika phala vyudāsāya śabdaḥ

original: svādhyāyamīmāṃsāprayojanavadarthādi śabdāḥ ubhayabhāgasādhāraṇāḥ | upaniṣadādayastvasādhāraṇāḥ | evamaikaśāstryaṃ, paurvāparyaniyamaḥ, brahmavicārārambhaṇīyatvaṃ cetyarthatrayamupapāditam |
analyzed: svādhyāya mīmāṃsā prayojana vat artha ādi śabdāḥ ubhaya bhāga sādhāraṇāḥ upaniṣad ādayaḥ tu asādhāraṇāḥ evam aikaśāstryam paurvāparya niyamaḥ brahma vicāra ārambhaṇīya tvam ca iti artha trayam upapāditam

original: tathā ca vedāntavākyāni kevalakarmaphalasya kṣayitvaṃ brahmajñānasya cākṣayaphalatvaṃ darśayanti ... ... pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti ityādīni ||

original: āpātadhījanakavākyāni santītyāha tathā ca iti | yathā sūtraṃ vyākhyātaṃ, tathā ityarthaḥ | kṣayiphalatvaparavākyopādānaṃ kvacinnirṇītārthasaṃvādadarśanādarthāntarāṇāmapi śraddheyatvāya | lokyata iti lokaḥ phalam | phaladvārā'ntavattvamuktam | antavat iti vākyaṃ kevalakarmaparam, aviditvā iti hi prakṛtam | dhruvaphalāsādhanatvamāha - na hi iti |
analyzed: āpāta dhī janaka vākyāni santi iti āha tathā ca iti yathā sūtram vyākhyātam tathā iti arthaḥ kṣayi phalatva para vākya upādānam kvacid nirṇīta artha saṃvāda darśanāt artha antarāṇām api śraddheya tvāya lokyate iti lokaḥ phalam phala dvārā antavattvam uktam antavat iti vākyam kevala karma param a viditvā iti hi prakṛtam dhruva phala asādhanatvam āha na hi iti

original: dhruvaṃ tat iti vākyakhaṇḍaḥ | tadupapādayati - plavā hi iti | iti karmaphalakṣayitvaparāṇi | athobhayaparam - parīkṣya iti | brāhmaṇaḥ brahma vedaḥ, tadadhīta ityaṇ | yaḥ ityadhyāhāryaḥ, saḥ ityukteḥ | akṛtaḥ - paraḥ puruṣaḥ | itiradhyāhāryaḥ | eva iti niyamavidhiḥ | śrotriyam - śrutavedāntam | brahmaniṣṭham - brahmasākṣātkāriṇam |
analyzed: dhruvam tat iti vākya khaṇḍaḥ tat upapādayati plavāḥ hi iti iti karma phala kṣayitva parāṇi atha ubhaya param parīkṣya iti brāhmaṇaḥ brahma vedaḥ tat adhīta iti aṇ yaḥ iti adhyāhāryaḥ saḥ iti ukteḥ akṛtaḥ paraḥ puruṣaḥ itiḥ adhyāhāryaḥ eva iti niyama vidhiḥ śrotriyam śruta vedāntam brahma niṣṭham brahma sākṣātkāriṇam

original: śamadamau śravaṇaupayikatādātvikāvadhānamātrahetū, na tvatyanta bāhyāntarakaraṇaviṣayaprāvaṇyatyāgaḥ | sa hi nirūpayiṣyate | akṣaraṃ satyaṃ - svarūpato guṇataścāvikāramiti cidacidvyāvṛttiḥ | provāca - prabrūyāt | chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ iti vidhau liṭ | athānantasthiraphalavākyāni | brahmavit iti vākyenānantyasiddhiḥ | yato vācaḥ iti hi prakaraṇam |

original: annavān ityādyavagatālpāsthira phaladākāśaprāṇādiśabdaiḥ tānyevānuvinaśyati ityanityatvādibhiśca saṃśayādyanativṛttiḥ | bhavān - anudāhṛtāspaṣṭārthavākyāntarajijñāsu | akṣayyaṃ ha vai apāma somamamṛtā abhūma ityādikaṃ pūrvabhāge'pi paśyetyarthaḥ | udāhṛtavākyaiḥ tṛptiścet uttaratrāpi syāt | anudāhṛtairatṛptiścet pūrvatrāpi syāt |

original: itthaṃ karmaṇa phaladvārā hānāya nirūpyatvamuktam | atha svarūpeṇopādānāya nirūpyatvamupapādayituṃ niyamenānapekṣitatvamukhena codayati - nanu ca iti | prathama evakāro'pekṣitadvitvavyudāsāya, dvitīyastvanapekṣitasya pūrvavṛttatvavyudāsāya | tataḥ kimityatrāha - na dharma iti | kuta ityatrāha - adhīta iti |

original: vedāntamātrādhyāyinastatraivā''pātapratīterityarthaḥ | yadvā kṛtsnādhyāyino'pi sukṛtavaśāt uttaratrāpekṣotpatteriti | tadā apekṣitāṃśasyāpyadhītatvam adhīta iti padārthaḥ | śaṅkate - karma iti | prastāvodgīthapratihāropadravanidhanākhyeṣu sāmāvayaveṣu dvitīya udgīthaḥ | upāsanasya karmāṅgatāpratītivyudāsāya āśraya śabdaḥ |

original: kathaṃ viśeṣapratyanīke'dhyāsaḥ? kathaṃ tannivṛttau karmānapekṣā? manasaḥ kathaṃ mālinyanairmalye? kaścārthasvabhāvaḥ? ityāśaṅkāyāmuktaṃ saṅkalayyadarśayati - etaduktam iti | svarūpatirodheradhyāsaḥ | bhedadarśanameva, na satyaṃ kimapi | tathā sati hi karmāpekṣā | tataḥ kiṃ bandhasya jñānamātranivartyatve ityatrāha - bandhaśca iti |
analyzed: katham viśeṣa pratyanīka idhyāsaḥ katham tad nivṛttau karma anapekṣā manasaḥ katham mālinya nairmalye kaḥ ca artha svabhāvaḥ iti āśaṅkāyām uktam saṅkalayya darśayati etat uktam iti svarūpa tirodheḥ adhyāsaḥ bheda darśanam eva na satyam kim api tathā sati hi karma apekṣā tatas kim bandhasya jñāna mātra nivartya tve iti atra āha bandhaḥ ca iti

original: samūlaḥ - avidyābhedadarśanasahitaḥ | jñānenaiva, na tu karmaṇā | na hi sarpabhramanivṛttau rajjudhīḥ karmāpekṣā | evaṃ samuccayavyudāsaḥ | atha karaṇatvaṃ vyudasyati - nivartakaṃ ca iti | tasya - karmānapekṣasya; etasya - advaitaviṣayasya | tatra hetuḥ vākyajanyatvam; kāryam bandhanivṛttiḥ | tarhi kutretyata āha - vividiṣāyameva iti |
analyzed: sa mūlaḥ avidyā bheda darśana sahitaḥ jñānena eva na tu karmaṇā na hi sarpa bhrama nivṛttau rajju dhīḥ karma apekṣā evam samuccaya vyudāsaḥ atha karaṇa tvam vyudasyati nivartakam ca iti tasya karma anapekṣasya etasya advaita viṣayasya tatra hetuḥ vākya janya tvam kāryam bandha nivṛttiḥ tarhi kutra iti atas āha vividiṣā ayam eva iti

original: śrutipratipannāyāmeveti bhāvaḥ | sa ca kathamityatrāha - sa ca iti | naivaṃ śrutamityatrāha - itīmam iti | imaṃ praṇāḍyā upayogam abhipretya uktamityarthaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti | ataḥ hānārthamupādānārthaṃ ca karmajñānasyānapekṣitatvādityarthaḥ | atra vyākhyātāra āhuḥ -
analyzed: śruti pratipannāyām eva iti bhāvaḥ sa ca katham iti atra āha sa ca iti na evam śrutam iti atra āha iti imam iti imam praṇāḍyā upayogam abhipretya uktam iti arthaḥ prakṛtam upasaṃharati atas iti atas hāna artham upādāna artham ca karma jñānasya anapekṣita tvāt iti arthaḥ atra vyākhyātāraḥ āhuḥ

original: birodhādapramāṇatvāccittaśuddhyupayojanāt |
analyzed: birodhāt apramāṇa tvāt citta śuddhi upayojanāt

original: jñānamātrasya hetutvaśruteḥ sāmarthyato'pi ca ||
analyzed: jñāna mātrasya hetu tva śruteḥ sāmarthya tā api ca

original: śamādyaṅgakatāmrānānna dhīkarmasamuccayaḥ |
analyzed: śama ādi aṅgaka tāmra anāt na dhī karma samuccayaḥ

original: śravaṇādikramonnidravākyajā dhīrvimocikā | |iti||
analyzed: śravaṇa ādi krama unnidra vākya jā dhīḥ vimocikā iti

analyzed: iti laghu pūrvapakṣaḥ

original: laghusiddhāntaḥ |

atrocyate - yaduktam avidyānivṛttireva mokṣaḥ, sā ca brahmavijñānādeva bhavati iti, tadabhyupagamyate | avidyānivṛttaye vedāntavākyairvidhitsitaṃ jñānaṃ kiṃrūpamiti vivecanīyam ... ... tāvanmātreṇāvidyānivṛttyanupalabdheśca||
analyzed: atrā ucyate yat uktam avidyā nivṛttiḥ eva mokṣaḥ sā ca brahma vijñānāt eva bhavati iti tat abhyupagamyate avidyā nivṛttaye vedānta vākyaiḥ vidhitsitam jñānam kiṃrūpam iti vivecanīyam tāvat mātreṇa avidyā nivṛtti anupalabdheḥ ca

original: asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhānta ucyata ityāha - atra iti | sādhyasādhanadvitvanirāsamabhyupagamena prativakti - yat iti | tarhi kutra vimatirityatrāha - avidyā iti | kiṃrūpam - karmāṅgakatvārhaṃ maduktaṃ jñānam, uta tadanarhaṃ tvaduktamiti sādhanaprakāraviśeṣe vimatiḥ | paramataṃ svamataṃ cāha - kiṃ vākyāt iti | na tu paramatavikalpaḥ |
analyzed: asmin pūrvapakṣe siddhāntaḥ ucyate iti āha atra iti sādhya sādhana dvitva nirāsam abhyupagamena prativakti yat iti tarhi kutra vimatiḥ iti atra āha avidyā iti kiṃrūpam karma aṅgaka tva arham mad uktam jñānam uta tad anarham tvad uktam iti sādhana prakāra viśeṣe vimatiḥ para matam sva matam ca āha kim vākyāt iti na tu para mata vikalpaḥ

original: tvanmatamayuktamityāha - na tāvat iti | na tu dūṣyaśirasoranyataradūṣaṇam | kuta ityapekṣāyāṃ vidhivaiyarthyaṃ hetumāha - tasya iti | na hi vyutpannasya śabdaśravaṇādarthabodho vidhyapekṣaḥ | pratyakṣavirodhaṃ ca hetumāha - tāvat iti | idaṃ dūṣaṇadvayam āpastabhbena coktaṃ - buddhe kṣemaprāpaṇaṃ, tacchāstrairvipratiṣiddham;
analyzed: tvad matam ayuktam iti āha na tāvat iti na tu dūṣya śirasoḥ anyatara dūṣaṇam kutas iti apekṣāyām vidhi vaiyarthyam hetum āha tasya iti na hi vyutpannasya śabda śravaṇāt artha bodhaḥ vidhi apekṣaḥ pratyakṣa virodham ca hetum āha tāvat iti idam dūṣaṇa dvayam āpastabhbena ca uktam buddhe kṣema prāpaṇam tad śāstraiḥ vipratiṣiddham

original: buddhe cet kṣemaprāpaṇamihaiva na duḥkhamupalabheta iti | upāsanadhruvānusmṛtidarśanabhakti yāvajjīvānuvṛttiniṣkramaṇamārgaviśeṣaparabahuśāstravirodhaḥ śāstrairiti vivakṣitaḥ | viśeṣataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ; prabalaiḥ pratiṣedhaḥ,? na tu samairuparodha ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: buddhe ced kṣema prāpaṇam iha eva na duḥkham upalabheta iti upāsana dhruva anusmṛti darśana bhakti yāvajjīva anuvṛtti niṣkramaṇa mārga viśeṣa para bahu śāstra virodhaḥ śāstraiḥ iti vivakṣitaḥ viśeṣataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ prabalaiḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na tu samaiḥ uparodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: na ca vācyam - medavāsanāyāmanirastāyāṃ vākyamavidyānivartakaṃ jñānaṃ na janayati ... ... ... ato vākyārthajñānādanyadeva dhyānopāsanādiśabdavācyaṃ jñānaṃ vedāntavākyairvidhitsitam ||
analyzed: na ca vācyam meda vāsanāyām anirastāyām vākyam avidyā nivartakam jñānam na janayati atas vākya artha jñānāt anyat eva dhyāna upāsana ādi śabda vācyam jñānam vedānta vākyaiḥ vidhitsitam

original: anayoḥ parihāradvayaṃ paroktamanūdya nirasyati - na ca iti | idānīmutpadyamānajñānavyāvṛttyarthamāha - avidyānivartakam iti | paścādapi tat vākyataścedadyaiva tatastat syādityata āha - bheda iti | vyāsādīnāmapi jñānānudayavādaḥ śrotṛdhiyo durāroha iti bādhitānuvṛttimāha - jāte'pi iti | sarvamūlāvidyaikyāt sarvasya ityaktam |
analyzed: anayoḥ parihāra dvayam para uktam anūdya nirasyati na ca iti idānīm utpadyamāna jñāna vyāvṛtti artham āha avidyā nivartakam iti paścāt api tat vākyataḥ ced adyā eva tatas tat syāt iti atas āha bhedaḥ iti vyāsa ādīnām api jñāna anudaya vādaḥ śrotṛ dhiyaḥ durārohaḥ iti bādhita anuvṛttim āha jātā api iti sarva mūla avidyā aikyāt sarvasya iti aktam

original: na doṣāya - mūlājñānānivartakatvaṃ na doṣāya | tarhibandhakaṃ syādityatrāha - anivṛttamapi iti | chinnamūlatvena - chinnāvidyākhyamūlatvena | śravaṇādervākyārthajñānopayogācchāstravirodhaparihāraśca arthāt siddha ityabhipretam | anutpattipakṣaṃ dūṣayati - satyām iti | nyāyānugṛhītavyutpannapadapaṅktirūpaṃ vākyam sāmagrī |
analyzed: na doṣāya mūla ajñāna anivartaka tvam na doṣāya tarhibandhakam syāt iti atra āha anivṛttam api iti chinna mūla tvena chinna avidyā ākhya mūla tvena śravaṇa ādeḥ vākya artha jñāna upayogāt śāstra virodha parihāraḥ ca arthāt siddhaḥ iti abhipretam anutpatti pakṣam dūṣayati satyām iti nyāya anugṛhīta vyutpanna padapaṅkti rūpam vākyam sāmagrī

original: pratibandhakasthityā tadvaikalyamāśaṃkyāha - satyāmapi iti |
analyzed: pratibandhaka sthityā tad vaikalyam āśaṃkya āha satyām api iti

original: bādhakotpattau bādhyā vāsanā na pratibandhiketyarthaḥ | bādhitānuvṛtiṃta dūṣayati - satyapi iti | bhavatā - kṛtsnamithyātvavādinā | bhavatā ityabhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti - bheda iti | aikyajñānodaye'pi kiṃ vāsanā sthitā, uta tannivṛttāvapi bhedadhīriti śirodvaye prathamaṃ dūṣayati - jñānotpattāvapi iti |
analyzed: bādhaka utpattau bādhyā vāsanā na pratibandhikā iti arthaḥ dūṣayati satī api iti bhavatā kṛtsna mithyātva vādinā bhavatā iti abhipretam vivṛṇoti bhedaḥ iti aikya jñāna udaye pi kim vāsanā sthitā uta tad nivṛttau api bheda dhīḥ iti śiraḥ dvaye prathamam dūṣayati jñāna utpattau api iti

original: svayaṃ nāśe tatklṛptibhramastasyāpi tatheti bhāvaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati - vāsanā iti | chinnamūlam - chinnavāsanākhyamūlam | bāliśabhāṣitam iti | muktirvinā jñānena syāt, tacca śravaṇādibhirvinā syāt, vinā'pi avidyayā jagadbhramaḥ syāt, sā ca vinā'dhiṣṭhānena syāt iti bhāvaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ dvicandrajñānānuvṛttirityatrāha - dvicandra iti |
analyzed: svayam nāśe tad klṛpti bhramaḥ tasya api tathā iti bhāvaḥ dvitīyam dūṣayati vāsanā iti chinna mūlam chinna vāsanā ākhya mūlam bāliśa bhāṣitam iti muktiḥ vinā jñānena syāt tat ca śravaṇa ādibhiḥ vinā syāt vinā api avidyayā jagat bhramaḥ syāt sā ca vinā adhiṣṭhānena syāt iti bhāvaḥ tarhi katham dvi candra jñāna anuvṛttiḥ iti atra āha dvi candre iti

original: timiraṃ pāramārthikaṃ, na mithyā iti tasya jñānābādhitatvāt | tarhi upadeśavaiyarthyamityatrāha - prabala iti | aindrajālikakṛtabhayādivyudāsāya prabala ityādipadam | yāthārthyāparokṣyārthaṃpravṛttidvārā vā sārthatvam | evaṃ parapakṣe bādhakasthitau bādhyasthitirahetukakāryodayaśca, svapakṣe tadubhayābhāva iti vaiṣamyaṃ darśitam |
analyzed: timiram pāramārthikam na mithyā iti tasya jñāna abādhita tvāt tarhi upadeśa vaiyarthyam iti atra āha prabalaḥ iti aindrajālika kṛta bhaya ādi vyudāsāya prabalaḥ iti ādi padam yāthārthya aparokṣya arthaṃpravṛtti dvārā vā sārthatvam evam para pakṣe bādhaka sthitau bādhya sthitiḥ ahetuka kārya udayaḥ ca sva pakṣe tad ubhaya abhāvaḥ iti vaiṣamyam darśitam

original: siṃhāvalokitakenānutpatiṃta dūṣayati - api ca iti | adṛṣṭadvārā cennivartyaṃ satyaṃ syāditi dṛṣṭadvārā nivartyatve dūṣaṇamidam | ataḥ pāriśeṣyānmuktyupāyajñānaṃ vākyārthadhiyo'nyadityāha - ataḥ iti ||
analyzed: dūṣayati api ca iti adṛṣṭa dvārā ced nivartyam satyam syāt iti dṛṣṭa dvārā nivartya tve dūṣaṇam idam atas pāriśeṣyāt mukti upāya jñānam vākya artha dhiyaḥ nyat iti āha atas iti

original: tathā ca śrutayaḥ - vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīta, anuvidya vijānāti ... ... ... yastadveda yat sa veda sa mayaitaduktaḥ ityatra, anu ma etāṃ bhagavo devatāṃ śādhi yāṃ devatāmupāsse iti ||
analyzed: tathā ca śrutayaḥ vijñāya prajñām kurvīta anuvidya vijānāti yaḥ tat veda yat sa veda sa mayā etat uktaḥ iti atra anu me etām bhagavaḥ devatām śādhi yām devatām upāsse iti

original: tathā ca iti | na paraṃ pāriśeṣyādavagamyate, śrūyate cetyarthaḥ | upasargaviśeṣasanvidhipratyaya yogāyoge'pyaikārthyajñāpanārthaṃ sāmānyaśabdānāṃ chāgapaśunyāyādviśeṣaparyavasānajñāpanārthaṃ cānekavākyopādānam | nicāyya - cāyṛ darśane | iti śabdaḥ svarūpe; evaṃ śabda upasargayogādiprakāre |
analyzed: tathā ca iti na param pāriśeṣyāt avagamyate śrūyate ca iti arthaḥ sāmānya śabdānām chāga paśu nyāyāt viśeṣa paryavasāna jñāpana artham ca aneka vākya upādānam nicāyya darśane iti śabdaḥ svarūpe evam śabdaḥ upasarga yoga ādi prakāre

original: prajñāṃ kurvīta ityādiṣu jñānamātraṃ vidheyaṃ pratīyate, na jñānaviśeṣa ityatrāha - atra iti | atra - udāhṛtavākyasamudāye | ādi śabdāt ātmānaṃ dhyāyatha ityādeḥ grahaṇam | chāgapaśunyāyāt dhyānarūpaviśeṣe paryavasānamityarthaḥ | tarhi lyabantapadābhyāṃ anveṣṭavyaḥ ityanena ca kimucyata ityatrāha - vākyārtha iti |
analyzed: prajñām kurvīta ityādiṣu jñāna mātram vidheyam pratīyate na jñāna viśeṣaḥ iti atra āha atra iti atra udāhṛta vākya samudāye ādi śabdāt ātmānam dhyāyatha ityādeḥ grahaṇam chāga paśu nyāyāt dhyāna rūpa viśeṣe paryavasānam iti arthaḥ tarhi lyap anta padābhyām anveṣṭavyaḥ iti anena ca kim ucyate iti atra āha vākya arthaḥ iti

original: sāmānyaśabdaḥ śravaṇādau viśeṣe paryavasyedityatrāha - śrotavyaḥ iti | śravaṇādiparyavasāne vidhyānarthakyādaprāptasya dhyānasya vidheyatvamāha – tasmāt iti | uktārthasya sautratāmāha - vakṣyati iti | sūtrārthamāha - tadidam iti | tṛtīyalakṣaṇāvasāne prakṛtaṃ śrutiṣu sāmānyaśadoktaṃ vā tadidam ityuktam | hetumāha - vidi - iti |
analyzed: sāmānya śabdaḥ śravaṇa ādau viśeṣe paryavasyet iti atra āha śrotavyaḥ iti śravaṇa ādi paryavasāne vidhi ānarthakyāt aprāptasya dhyānasya vidheya tvam āha tasmāt iti ukta arthasya sautra tām āha vakṣyati iti sūtra artham āha tat idam iti tṛtīya lakṣaṇa avasāne prakṛtam śrutiṣu sāmānya śada uktam vā tat idam iti uktam hetum āha vidi iti

original: sthalatrayamudāharati - manaḥ iti | na sa ityādau vyavadhānābhāvanna atra śabdaḥ | atrādau copāsiḥ śrutaḥ, atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste iti | kvacidādau, kvacidādyantayoḥ, kvacidante ca viśeṣaśabdaḥ | kvacidante, kvacinmadhye, kvacidādau ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ ityudāharaṇatrayavibhāgaḥ | idaṃ vākyaṃ rātrisatra vākyavat draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: sthala trayam udāharati manaḥ iti na saḥ ityādau atra śabdaḥ atra ādau ca upāsiḥ śrutaḥ atha yonyām devatām upāste iti kvacid ādau kvacid ādi antayoḥ kvacid ante ca viśeṣa śabdaḥ kvacid ante kvacid madhye kvacid ādau ca sāmānya śabdaḥ iti udāharaṇa traya vibhāgaḥ idam vākyam rātri satra vākya vat draṣṭavyam

original: tatra hi vidhivākyanirdiṣṭā rātrīḥ arthavāde ya etā rātrīḥ ityanūdya phalatvena pratiṣṭhā samarpyate | tadvadatrāpi vidhivākyanirdiṣṭamupāsanamarthavāde ya evaṃ veda iti vidinā'nūdya, tatphalatvena bhāti ca ityādinā bhānatapane samarpyete | yastat iti | yaḥ - veditā raikvaḥ; yat -vedyaṃ brahma; saḥ - etaccobhayaṃ tavoktamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra hi vidhi vākya nirdiṣṭāḥ rātrīḥ arthavāde yaḥ etāḥ rātrīḥ iti anūdya phala tvena pratiṣṭhā samarpyate tadvat atra api vidhi vākya nirdiṣṭam upāsanam arthavāde yaḥ evam veda iti tad phala tvena bhāti ca ityādinā bhāna tapane samarpyete yaḥ tat iti yaḥ veditā raikvaḥ yat vedyam brahma saḥ etat ca ubhayam tava uktam iti arthaḥ

original: me anuśādhi ityanvayaḥ | kasmiṃścit prakaraṇe sāmānyaśabdanirdiṣṭasya tattulyaprakaraṇāntare viśeṣaśabdenoktiḥ prāguktā | ekaikasmin prakaraṇe vyatikareṇoktiratroktā | etat dvayamapi sūtre pūrvatra ca hetutayā vivakṣitam | ekatroktirlāghavāya | tadidam ityādi sūtravyākhyānam |
analyzed: me anuśādhi iti anvayaḥ kasmiṃścid prakaraṇe sāmānya śabda nirdiṣṭasya tad tulya prakaraṇa antare viśeṣa śabdena uktiḥ prāk uktā ekaikasmin prakaraṇe vyatikareṇa uktiḥ atra uktā etat dvayam api sūtre pūrvatra ca hetutayā vivakṣitam ekatra uktiḥ lāghavāya tat idam ityādi sūtra vyākhyānam

original: na cet apavargopāyatayā vidhitsitaṃ dhyānam i tyucyet, na tu vedanamiti | anyathā śrṛṅkhalitoktiprakaraṇavairūpyāt ||
analyzed: na ced apavarga upāya tayā vidhitsitam dhyānam i ti ucyet na tu vedanam iti anyathā śrṛṅkhalita ukti prakaraṇa vairūpyāt

original: dhyānaṃ ca tailadhārāvadavicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpam - dhruvāsmṛtiḥ | ... ... ... ... ... ... upāsanaṃ syāt dhruvānusmṛtirdarśanānnirvacanācca iti tasyaiva vedanasyopāsanarūpasyāsakṛdāvṛttasya dhruvānusmṛtitvamupavarṇitam ||
analyzed: dhyānam ca taila dhārā vat avicchinna smṛti santāna rūpam dhruvā asmṛtiḥ upāsanam syāt dhruvā anusmṛtiḥ darśanāt nirvacanāt ca iti tasya eva vedanasya upāsana rūpasya asakṛt āvṛttasya dhruva anusmṛti tvam upavarṇitam

original: pūrvaprakṛtadhyānaṃ viśinaṣṭi - dhyānaṃ ca iti | smṛtīnāṃ dhruvatvaṃ vijātīyasmṛtyavyavadhānam | apavargopāyatvaśravaṇāt - nididhyāsitavyaḥ ityādivihitadhyānameva dhruvā smṛtiḥ ityatra phalaikyādavagatamityarthaḥ | katipayaviśeṣaṃ pradarśayataḥ sūtrakṛto'bhipretaṃ viśeṣāntaramāha - sā ca iti | samānākāratvam - viśadāvabhāsarūpatvam |
analyzed: pūrva prakṛta dhyānam viśinaṣṭi dhyānam ca iti smṛtīnām dhruva tvam vijātīya smṛti avyavadhānam apavarga upāya tva śravaṇāt nididhyāsitavyaḥ ityādi vihita dhyānam eva dhruvā smṛtiḥ iti atra phala aikyāt avagatam iti arthaḥ katipaya viśeṣam pradarśayataḥ sūtrakṛtaḥ abhipretam viśeṣa antaram āha sā ca iti samāna ākāra tvam viśada avabhāsa rūpatvam

original: kuta ityatrāha bhidyate iti | hṛdayagranthiḥ - ajñānam; yadvā hṛdayaḥ - hṛdgataḥ ātmā,tasya granthiḥ - prakṛtisaṃbandhaḥ | upāyaphalānubhavadaśāsādhāraṇyāt prāgavivṛtasya draṣṭavyaḥ iti padasyārthamāha - evam iti | evaṃ ca sati -nirṇāyakavākyāntare sati ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ smṛterdarśanarūpatetyatrāha bhavati iti |
analyzed: kutas iti atra āha bhidyate iti hṛdaya granthiḥ ajñānam yat vā hṛdayaḥ hṛd gataḥ ātmā atasya granthiḥ prakṛti saṃbandhaḥ upāya phala anubhava daśā sādhāraṇyāt prāk avivṛtasya draṣṭavyaḥ iti padasya artham āha evam iti evam ca sati nirṇāyaka vākya antare sati iti arthaḥ katham smṛteḥ darśana rūpa tā iti atra āha bhavati iti

original: vṛkṣe vṛkṣe ca paśyāmi itivaditi bhāvaḥ | athamarthaḥ sūtratātparyajñairapyukta ityāha - vākya iti | prapañcitam - pūrvapakṣasiddhāntarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | tadviṣaye śravaṇāt - vyatikaraprayogādinetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vṛkṣe vṛkṣe ca paśyāmi itivat iti bhāvaḥ atham arthaḥ sūtra tātparya jñaiḥ api uktaḥ iti āha vākye iti prapañcitam pūrvapakṣa siddhānta rūpeṇa iti arthaḥ tad viṣaye śravaṇāt vyatikara prayoga ādinā iti arthaḥ

original: vākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe - sarvāsu iti | na paraṃ chāndogya iti bhāvaḥ | mokṣasādhanatayā vihitam iti arthāntaradhīśravaṇādivyudāsaḥ | uktārthasya pūrvapakṣatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha - sakṛt iti | siddham - siddhāntaḥ | dvitrāvṛttimātravyudāsāya asakṛt - śabdaḥ | sūtrābhipretasya vākye kaṇṭhokiṃta darśayati - upāsanam iti | tasyaiva - mokṣasādhanasyaiva |
analyzed: vākyam vyācaṣṭe sarvāsu iti na param chāndogye iti bhāvaḥ mokṣa sādhanatayā vihitam iti artha antara dhī śravaṇa ādi vyudāsaḥ ukta arthasya pūrvapakṣa tva śaṅkā vyudāsāya āha sakṛt iti siddham siddhāntaḥ dvitra āvṛtti mātra vyudāsāya asakṛt śabdaḥ sūtra abhipretasya vākye darśayati upāsanam iti tasya eva mokṣa sādhanasya eva

original: upāsanaśabdavācyatvādasakṛdāvṛttatvam ||
analyzed: upāsana śabda vācya tvāt asakṛt āvṛtta tvam

original: seyaṃ smṛtirdarśanarūpā pratipāditā | darśanarūpatā ca pratyakṣatāpattiḥ | ... ... ... ... ... priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ iti ca || ataḥ sākṣātkārarūpā smṛtiḥ ... ... tenaiva labhyate para ātmetyuktaṃ bhavati ||
analyzed: sā iyam smṛtiḥ darśana rūpā pratipāditā darśana rūpa tā ca pratyakṣa tā āpattiḥ priyaḥ hi jñāninā utyartham aham sa ca mama priyaḥ iti ca atas sākṣātkāra rūpā smṛtiḥ tena eva labhyate paraḥ ātmā iti uktam bhavati

original: vākyakṛto'pyabhipretaṃ viśeṣāntaraṃ prāgasmaduktamityāha - seyam iti | vākyakāreṇaiva tulyanyāyatayā'rthāduktamiti vārthaḥ | seyam - asakṛdāvṛttā dhruvā ca | dīṃrghadarśī itivat darśanaśabdasya dhīsāmānyaparatvaṃ mā bhūdityāha - darśana iti | pratyakṣasamānākāratāpattirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vākyakṛtā api abhipretam viśeṣa antaram prāk asmat uktam iti āha sā iyam iti vākyakāreṇa eva tulya nyāyatayā arthāt uktam iti vā arthaḥ sā iyam asakṛt āvṛttā dhruvā ca dīṃrghadarśī iti vat darśana śabdasya dhī sāmānya paratvam mā bhūt iti āha darśane iti pratyakṣa samāna ākāratā āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: śrotavya ityādidhīviśeṣāntaravācipadaiḥ samabhivyāhārāt draṣṭavya ityasyāparokṣyarūpadhīviśeṣaparatvameva nyāyyamiti bhāvaḥ | viśeṣāntaraparā śrutirastītyāha - evam iti | evam - sāmānyaviśeṣanayāditi bhāvaḥ | pravacanam mananam; kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ |
analyzed: śrotavyaḥ ityādi dhī viśeṣa antara vāci padaiḥ samabhivyāhārāt draṣṭavyaḥ iti asya aparokṣya rūpa dhī viśeṣa paratvam eva nyāyyam iti bhāvaḥ viśeṣa antara parā śrutiḥ asti iti āha evam iti evam sāmānya viśeṣa nayāt iti bhāvaḥ pravacanam mananam kāraṇe kārya upacāraḥ

original: atra kathaṃ smṛterviśeṣitatvaṃ, dhyānāderanupāyatvameva pratīyata ityāśaṅkāyāṃ prathamapratītamarthamāha - anena iti | na pṛthivyāmagniḥ cetavyaḥ itivaditi kevala śabdasya bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityapekṣāyāṃ lokanīrtiṃ darśayati - priya iti | tato'pi kimityatrāha - yasya iti | yasya upāsakasya; ayam - paramātmā |
analyzed: atra katham smṛteḥ viśeṣita tvam dhyāna ādeḥ anupāya tvam eva pratīyate iti āśaṅkāyām prathama pratītam artham āha anena iti na pṛthivyām agniḥ cetavyaḥ itivat iti kevala śabdasya bhāvaḥ tatas kim iti apekṣāyām loka nīrtim darśayati priyaḥ iti tatas api kim iti atra āha yasya iti yasya upāsakasya ayam paramātmā

original: paramātmaviṣayaprītimata eva tatprītiviṣayatvamityatra mānatayā priyatamatvakāryavaraṇavivaraṇāya smṛtimarthapūrvakaṃ darśayati - yathā iti | ayam - bhagavati prītimān | satatayuktānām - āśaṃsāyāṃ ktaḥ | tadvivaraṇāyāha - priyo hi iti | lokasmṛtyanugṛhītaśrutyā dhruvānusmṛterviśeṣitatvaṃ darśayati - ataḥ iti |
analyzed: paramātma viṣaya prītimataḥ eva tad prīti viṣayatvam iti atra mānatayā priyatama tva kārya varaṇa vivaraṇāya smṛtim artha pūrvakam darśayati yathā iti ayam bhagavati prītimān satata yuktānām āśaṃsāyām ktaḥ tad vivaraṇāya āha priyaḥ hi iti loka smṛti anugṛhīta śrutyā dhruva anusmṛteḥ viśeṣita tvam darśayati atas iti

original: smaryamāṇātyarthapriyatvena - arthenaiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyām iti bhāvaḥ | atyarthapriyā - atyarthānukūlā ||
analyzed: smaryamāṇa atyartha priya tvena arthena eva viśeṣaḥ hi nirākāra tayā dhiyām iti bhāvaḥ atyartha priyā atyartha anukūlā

original: evaṃrūpā dhruvānusmṛtireva bhaktiśabdenābhidhīyate, upāsanaparyāyatvāt bhaktiśabdasya | ... ... ... ... puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārthabhaktyā labhyastvananyayā iti ||
analyzed: evaṃrūpā dhruva anusmṛtiḥ eva bhakti śabdena abhidhīyate upāsana paryāya tvāt bhakti śabdasya puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyaḥ tu ananyayā iti

original: tarhi kathaṃ bhakterupāyatvoktirityatrāha - evam iti | sevā bhaktirupāstiḥ iti hi naighaṇṭukāḥ | bahuśrutyaikārthyānmokṣopāyavedanasya bhaktirūpatvamupapādya, atha śratismṛtyaikārthyādeva tadupapādayati - ata eva iti | ataḥ -bhaktirūpopāsanasya muktyupāyavedanatvāt |
analyzed: tarhi katham bhakteḥ upāya tva uktiḥ iti atra āha evam iti sevā bhaktiḥ upāstiḥ iti hi naighaṇṭukāḥ bahuśrutyā aikārthyāt mokṣa upāya vedanasya bhakti rūpa tvam upapādya atha śrati smṛtyā aikārthyāt eva tat upapādayati atas eva iti atas bhakti rūpa upāsanasya mukti upāya vedana tvāt

original: yasmāt paraṃ nāparam mahān prabhurvai puruṣa iti pūrvāparāvagatabhagavatparo madhyasthaśivaśabdaḥ puruṣasūktaikārthyāditi jñāpanāya śvetāśvataravākyamupāttam | upāyāntaraniṣedhakaṇṭhoktyā tato māṃ tattvataḥ iti vākyārthaniścāyakatayā jñānadarśanaprāptīnāṃ bhaktisādhyatvakaṇṭhoktyā nāhaṃ vedaiḥ ityudāhṛtam |
analyzed: yasmāt param na aparam mahān prabhuḥ vai puruṣaḥ iti pūrva apara avagata bhagavat paraḥ madhya stha śiva śabdaḥ puruṣasūkta aikārthyāt iti jñāpanāya śvetāśvatara vākyam upāttam upāya antara niṣedha kaṇṭhoktyā tatas mām tattvataḥ iti vākya artha niścāyaka tayā jñāna darśana prāptīnām bhakti sādhya tva kaṇṭhoktyā na aham vedaiḥ iti udāhṛtam

original: viṣayaikyapratyabhijñayā tadupāyaikyamiti jñāpanāya puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ ityādyupāttam ||
analyzed: viṣaya aikya pratyabhijñayā tad upāya aikyam iti jñāpanāya puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ ityādi upāttam

original: evaṃrūpāyāḥ dhruvānusmṛteḥ sādhanāni yajñādīni karmāṇi iti yajñādiśruteraśvavat ... ... ... ... evaṃniyamayuktasyā''śramavihitakarmānuṣṭhānenaiva vidyāniṣpattirityuktaṃ bhavati ||
analyzed: evaṃrūpāyāḥ dhruva anusmṛteḥ sādhanāni yajña ādīni karmāṇi iti yajña ādi śruteḥ aśva vat evam niyama yuktasya āśrama vihita karma anuṣṭhānena eva vidyā niṣpattiḥ iti uktam bhavati

original: evamastu, tataḥ kiṃ karmasāpekṣatvasyetyatrāha - evaṃrūpāyā iti | evaṃrūpāyāḥ - uktānekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāyāḥ | tattadavasthābhedaḥ karmasādhya iti bhāvaḥ | dhruvānusmṛteḥ - na tu vividiṣāyā ityarthaḥ | paramasādhyecchorevāvāntarasādhye pravṛtteḥ, vedanecchoreva tadarthecchārthamanuṣṭhānamityātmāśraya iti bhāvaḥ | abhyupetyāha - yadyapi iti |
analyzed: evam astu tatas kim karma sāpekṣatvasya iti atra āha evaṃrūpāyāḥ iti evaṃrūpāyāḥ ukta aneka viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāḥ tad tad avasthā bhedaḥ karma sādhyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ dhruva anusmṛteḥ na tu vividiṣāyāḥ iti arthaḥ parama sādhya icchoḥ eva avāntara sādhye pravṛtteḥ vedanā icchoḥ eva tad artha icchā artham anuṣṭhānam iti ātma āśrayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ abhyupetya āha yadi api iti

original: tadutpattaye - vividiṣotpattaye | vidyāyāḥ karmaṇaśca yāvajjīvānuvṛttāvāśrama śeṣasya vidyāṅgatve ca sūtrāṇi darśayati - vakṣyati ca iti ||
analyzed: tad utpattaye vividiṣā utpattaye vidyāyāḥ karmaṇaḥ ca yāvat jīva anuvṛttau āśrama śeṣasya vidyā aṅga tve ca sūtrāṇi darśayati vakṣyati ca iti

original: athāpramāṇatāṃ śamādivirodhaṃ ca parijihīrṣannāha - vākya iti | dhruvānusmṛteḥ ityanena vākyasthatacchabdo vyākhyātaḥ | kevalasya yajñādeḥ śamādeśca vyudāsāya evakāraḥ | itaretarayoge dvandvaḥ; tena vikalpavyudāsaḥ | sa hi pratītyanuṣṭhityapūrvaphalānāṃ pākṣikabādhairaṣṭadoṣaḥ | saṃbhavaḥ - yuktiḥ | nirvacanam - āgamaḥ |
analyzed: atha apramāṇatām śama ādi virodham ca parijihīrṣan āha vākye iti dhruva anusmṛteḥ iti anena vākya stha tad śabdaḥ vyākhyātaḥ kevalasya yajña ādeḥ śama ādeḥ ca vyudāsāya eva kāraḥ itaretara yoge dvandvaḥ tena vikalpa vyudāsaḥ sa hi pratīti anuṣṭhiti apūrva phalānām pākṣika bādhaiḥ aṣṭa doṣaḥ saṃbhavaḥ yuktiḥ nirvacanam āgamaḥ

original: ke punaste? kathaṃ ca śamādyavirodhaḥ? ityatrāha - viveka iti | itiḥ bhāṣyoktiḥ, atra ityādiśca | viṣayānabhuktvā sthātumaśaktiryena sa vikāraḥ abhiṣvaṅgaḥ | anabhiṣvaṅgena krodhādyabhāvaśca phalitaḥ | kāmāddhi krodhaḥ | āraṃbaṇam - ālaṃbanam, śubhāśrayaḥ | nātra sādhyāviśiṣṭatā, kālāntarasaṃśīlanasya yogopakārakatvāt |
analyzed: ke punar te katham ca śama ādi avirodhaḥ iti atra āha vivekaḥ iti itiḥ bhāṣya uktiḥ atra ityādiḥ ca viṣayān a bhuktvā sthātum aśaktiḥ yena sa vikāraḥ abhiṣvaṅgaḥ anabhiṣvaṅgena krodha ādi abhāvaḥ ca phalitaḥ kāmāt hi krodhaḥ āraṃbaṇam ālaṃbanam śubha āśrayaḥ na atra sādhya aviśiṣṭa tā kāla antara saṃśīlanasya yoga upakāraka tvāt

original: bhāṣyakāraḥ - dramiḍācāryaḥ | ataḥ sarvaṃ nirvacanaṃ tena darśitamiti vijñāyate | smārtam iti | śrautasya atha muniḥ ityasyāsphuṭārthatvāt sphuṭārthaṃsmārtaṃ darśitam | śaktitaḥ -na hyaśakyaṃ vidhīyate | brahmavidām - na tu brahmavividiṣūṇām | kriyāśabdavivaraṇamāha - tametam iti |
analyzed: bhāṣyakāraḥ dramiḍa ācāryaḥ atas sarvam nirvacanam tena darśitam iti vijñāyate smārtam iti śrautasya atha muniḥ iti asya asphuṭa artha tvāt sphuṭa artha smārtam darśitam śaktitaḥ na hi aśakyam vidhīyate brahma vidām na tu brahma vividiṣūṇām kriyā śabda vivaraṇam āha tam etam iti

original: abhidhyā - parakīye svatvabuddhiḥ, parakṛtāpakārānavaratasmaraṇaṃ vā, niṣphalacintā vā | ādi śabdaḥ amānitvamadaṃbhitvamahisā kṣāntirārjavam ityādyārjavādiparavākyaparaḥ | śokavastu - śokanimittaṃ vastu | ādi śabdena bhayanimittaṃ vastūktam| atītāgāmyaniṣṭajñānanimittacittavikārau śokabhaye | ca śabdo bhinnakramaḥ |
analyzed: abhidhyā parakīye sva tva buddhiḥ para kṛta apakāra anavarata smaraṇam vā niṣphala cintā vā ādi śabdaḥ amāni tvam adaṃbhi tvam ahisā kṣāntiḥ ārjavam iti ādi ārjava ādi para vākya paraḥ śoka vastu śoka nimittam vastu ādi śabdena bhaya nimittam vastu uktam atīta agāmi aniṣṭa jñāna nimitta citta vikārau śoka bhaye ca śabdaḥ bhinna kramaḥ

original: tajjaṃ ca - bandhujanadainyadarśanajaṃ ca dainyamityarthaḥ | abhāsvaratvam - svapravṛttyakṣamatvam - dainya śabdavivaraṇaṃ; bhāsvaratvavirodhīti dainya viśeṣaṇam vā | yadvā bhinnavākyatayā yojanīyam - deśakālavaiguṇyācchokavastvādyanusmṛteśca janitamabhāsvaratvaṃ manaso'vasādaḥ | kimuktaṃ bhavatītyata āha - tajjaṃ dainyam iti |
analyzed: tad jam ca bandhu jana dainya darśana jam ca dainyam iti arthaḥ abhāsvara tvam sva pravṛtti akṣamatvam dainya śabda vivaraṇam bhāsvara tva virodhi iti dainya viśeṣaṇam vā yat vā bhinna vākyatayā yojanīyam deśa kāla vaiguṇyāt śoka vastu ādi anusmṛteḥ ca janitam abhāsvara tvam manasaḥ uvasādaḥ kim uktam bhavati iti atas āha tad jam dainyam iti

original: deśakālavaiguṇyādijanitaṃ manaso dainyam avasādaḥ ityukta bhavati | avasādalakṣaṇamātraṃ vākyoktam | tadviparyayaḥ iti tu bhāṣyam | balaṃ - manobalam | tadviparyayajā iti | deśakālasādguṇyātītānāgataprītinimittavastujñānādijā | uddharṣa lakṣaṇena tadviparyayaḥ phalita iti noktaḥ |
analyzed: deśa kāla vaiguṇya ādi janitam manasaḥ dainyam avasādaḥ iti ukta bhavati avasāda lakṣaṇa mātram vākya uktam tad viparyayaḥ iti tu bhāṣyam balam manaḥ balam tad viparyaya jāḥ iti deśa kāla sādguṇya atīta anāgata prīti nimitta vastu jñāna ādi jāḥ ud harṣa lakṣaṇena tad viparyayaḥ phalitaḥ iti na uktaḥ

original: kathaṃ svādhyāyaśaucasantoṣa ityādiṣu yogāṅgatayoktasya santoṣasya heyatvamityatrāha - ati iti | padeṣu vyākhyāteṣu vākyārthamāha - evam iti | pravṛttinivṛttirūpatāvibhāgāt pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ | tvadabhimatenaiveti eva kārābhiprāyaḥ | avihitaniṣiddhakāmyanivṛttirūpaśamādeḥ vihitapravṛttirūpayajñādeśca virodha ityabhiprāyaḥ ||
analyzed: katham svādhyāya śauca santoṣaḥ ityādiṣu yoga aṅgatayā uktasya santoṣasya heya tvam iti atra āha ati iti padeṣu vyākhyāteṣu vākya artham āha evam iti pravṛtti nivṛtti rūpatā vibhāgāt pṛthak nirdeśaḥ tvad abhimatena eva iti eva kārā abhiprāyaḥ avihita niṣiddha kāmya nivṛtti rūpa śama ādeḥ vihita pravṛtti rūpa yajña ādeḥ ca virodhaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: tathā ca śrutyantaram - vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yastadvedobhayaṃ saha | ... ... ... ... brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāya tartuṃ mṛtyumavidyayā ||iti||
analyzed: tathā ca śruti antaram vidyām ca avidyām ca yaḥ tat veda ubhayam saha brahma vidyām adhiṣṭhāya tartum mṛtyum avidyayā iti

original: mānaṃ ca darśitam | atha svamate śrutyantaraṃ ca pramāṇayan śaṅkarayādavaprakāśamatayojane ca vyudasyan vidyāṃ ca iti śrutimupādāya vyācaṣṭe - tathā ca śrutyantaram ityādinā | śrutyantaram iti - sanrahitatayā yajñādiśrutivilakṣaṇā | samasamuccayavādibhiśca tatparatayā ca svīkṛtā śrutirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: mānam ca darśitam atha sva mate śruti antaram ca pramāṇayan śaṅkara yādavaprakāśa mata yojane ca vyudasyan vidyām ca iti śrutim upādāya vyācaṣṭe tathā ca śruti antaram ityādinā śruti antaram iti san rahitatayā yajña ādi śruti vilakṣaṇā sama samuccaya vādibhiḥ ca tad para tayā ca svīkṛtā śrutiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: paraiḥ svābhimatapramāṇatayoktamapi maduktārthaparamityarthaḥ | atra kiṃ karmavācītyatrāha - atra iti | atra - na tu śrūyatāṃ cāpyavidyāyāḥ ityādau | padadvayena vihitakarmājñānavyudāsaḥ | vākyārthaṃ yojayati - avidyayā iti | jñānotpattivirodhi; na tu phalavividiṣāvirodhīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: paraiḥ sva abhimata pramāṇatayā uktam api mad ukta artha param iti arthaḥ atra kim karma vāci iti atra āha atra iti atra na tu śrūyatām ca api avidyāyāḥ ityādau pada dvayena vihita karma ajñāna vyudāsaḥ vākya artham yojayati avidyayā iti jñāna utpatti virodhi na tu phala vividiṣā virodhi iti bhāvaḥ

original: prācīnaṃ karma - na tu vidyāvaduttarapūrvāghavirodhitvamiti bhāvaḥ | tīrtvā - apohya | prāpya sthitaḥ iti asvārasyamadhyāhāraśca gatyantarasadbhāvānna yujyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: prācīnam karma na tu vidyā vat uttara pūrva agha virodhi tvam iti bhāvaḥ tīrtvā apohya prāpya sthitaḥ iti asvārasyam adhyāhāraḥ ca gati antara sadbhāvāt na yujyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: karmajñāna śabdābhyāṃ kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravartate iti smṛti smāritā phalopāyavirodhisādhāraṇasya mṛtyuśabdasya prakṛtipratyayārthavedanatadicchāhetusādhāraṇasya yajñādivākyasya cārthaniṣkarṣārtham | asyāṃ smṛtau, tato jñānaṃ pravartate iti hi karmasādhyatayā jñānamevocyate; na tu mokṣo vā vividiṣā vā |
analyzed: karma jñāna śabdābhyām kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tatas jñānam pravartate iti smṛti smāritā phala upāya virodhi sādhāraṇasya mṛtyu śabdasya prakṛti pratyaya artha vedana tad icchā hetu sādhāraṇasya yajña ādi vākyasya ca artha niṣkarṣa artham asyām smṛtau tatas jñānam pravartate iti hi karma sādhya tayā jñānam eva ucyate na tu mokṣaḥ vā vividiṣā vā

original: avidyā śabdasya karmavācitvaṃ sahetukaṃ darśayati -mṛtyutaraṇa iti | pratītā - pratītisvārasyādityarthaḥ | vidyetarat tadanyārthe nañ ityarthaḥ | na tvavihitakarma jñānaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | uktaṃ spaṣṭayitumāha - yathoktam iti | jñānam - āgamottham; vidyā - vivekādijā | tartum iti | tarateḥ prāptyarthatvavyudāsaḥ ||
analyzed: avidyā śabdasya karma vāci tvam sa hetukam darśayati mṛtyu taraṇe iti pratītā pratīti svārasyāt iti arthaḥ vidyā itarat tad anya arthe nañ iti arthaḥ na tu avihita karma jñānam ca iti bhāvaḥ uktam spaṣṭayitum āha yathā uktam iti jñānam āgama uttham vidyā viveka ādi jā tartum iti tarateḥ prāpti artha tva vyudāsaḥ

original: jñānavirodhi ca karma puṇyapāparūpam | brahmajñānotpattivirodhitvenāniṣṭaphalatayā ... ... ... ... karmamīmāṃsāvaseyamiti, saivāpekṣitā brahmajijñāsāyāḥ pūrvavṛttā vaktavyā ||
analyzed: jñāna virodhi ca karma puṇya pāpa rūpam brahma jñāna utpatti virodhi tvena aniṣṭa phala tayā karma mīmāṃsā avaseyam iti sā eva apekṣitā brahma jijñāsāyāḥ pūrva vṛttā vaktavyā

original: karmamātrasya nirasanīyatvoktirayuktā, pāpameva hi dharmanirasanīyaṃ śrūyata ityāśaṅkyāha - jñāna iti | kathaṃ puṇyapāparūpasya karmaṇaḥ pāpamapanudati iti pāpaśabdena nirdeśa ityatrāha - brahma iti | na sukṛtaṃ, na duṣkṛtaṃ, sarve pāpmānaḥ iti prayogo'pyabhipretaḥ | rajastamasī hi tadvirodhinī ityatrāha - asya ca iti |
analyzed: karma mātrasya nirasanīya tva uktiḥ ayuktā pāpam eva hi dharma nirasanīyam śrūyate iti āśaṅkya āha jñāne iti katham puṇya pāpa rūpasya karmaṇaḥ pāpam apanudati iti pāpa śabdena nirdeśaḥ iti atra āha brahma iti na sukṛtam na duṣkṛtam sarve pāpmānaḥ iti prayogaḥ upi abhipretaḥ rajaḥ tamasī hi tad virodhinī iti atra āha asya ca iti

original: asya tayośca tādṛktve prāmāṇike hi dvāradvāribhāvaklṛptirityatrāha - pāpasya ca iti | adho nayanam -upāstivaimukhyakaraṇaṃ saṃsārapatanahetutayā tatroktā | rajastamasostathātvaṃ darśayati raja iti | eva ityāptatamatvasūcanam ||
analyzed: asya tayoḥ ca tādṛktve prāmāṇike hi dvāra dvāri bhāva klṛptiḥ iti atra āha pāpasya ca iti adhas nayanam upāsti vaimukhya karaṇam saṃsāra patana hetutayā tatra uktāḥ rajaḥ tamasoḥ tathātvam darśayati rajaḥ iti eva iti āptatama tva sūcanam

original: tataḥ kimityatrāha - ataśca iti | caḥ tvarthaḥ śaṅkānivṛttiparaḥ | anvayavyatirekasamuccayaparo vā | kena nirāsa ityatrāha tat iti | anuṣṭhitena - na tu jñātamātreṇa | avidyāśabdārthasya nirāsakasya dharmatvaṃ, mṛtyuśabdārthasya nirasanīyasya ca pāpatva spaṣṭayantīṃ śrutiṃ darśayati - tathā ca iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - tadevam iti |
analyzed: tatas kim iti atra āha atas ca iti caḥ tu arthaḥ śaṅkā nivṛtti paraḥ anvaya vyatireka samuccaya paraḥ vā kena nirāsaḥ iti atra āha tat iti anuṣṭhitena na tu jñāta mātreṇa avidyā śabda arthasya nirāsakasya dharma tvam mṛtyu śabda arthasya nirasanīyasya ca spaṣṭayantīm śrutim darśayati tathā ca iti tatas kim iti atra āha tat evam iti

original: tat - śrutismṛtyupapattisūtravākyakāravacanaiḥ | evam - svotpattivirodhinirāsāya | tataḥ kiṃ brahmavicārasya karmavicārāpekṣatva ityatrāha - ataḥ iti | ataḥ - brahmavidyāyāḥ karmasāpekṣatvāt | apekṣita - iti | hānāyopādānāya cetyarthaḥ | saiva - tvatpratikṣiptaiveti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: tat śruti smṛti upapatti sūtra vākya kāra vacanaiḥ evam sva utpatti virodhi nirāsāya tatas kim brahma vicārasya karma vicāra apekṣa tve iti atra āha atas iti atas brahma vidyāyāḥ karma sāpekṣa tvāt apekṣitaḥ iti hānāya upādānāya ca iti arthaḥ sā eva tvad pratikṣiptā eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: api ca nityānityavastuvivekādayaśca mīmāṃsāśravaṇamantareṇa na saṃpatsyante ... ... ... tatsādguṇyāpādanānyetāni sutarāmihaiva saṅgatāni | teṣāṃ ca karmasvarūpādhigamāpekṣā sarvasammatā ||
analyzed: api ca nitya anitya vastu viveka ādayaḥ ca mīmāṃsā śravaṇam antareṇa na saṃpatsyante tad sādguṇya āpādanāni etāni sutarām iha eva teṣām ca karma svarūpa adhigama apekṣā sarva sammatā

original: evaṃ karmavicārasya pūrvavṛttatvamupapāditam; atha paroktasādhanacatuṣṭayasya pūrvavṛttatvaṃ nirasyati - api ca iti | mīmāṃsā ityubhayabhāgoktiḥ | phalam - bhuktimuktī; karaṇam - yajñādikamupāsanaṃ ca; itikartavyatā - prayājādikā sādhanasaptakaṃ ca; bubhukṣurmumukṣuścādhikārī |
analyzed: evam karma vicārasya pūrva vṛtta tvam upapāditam atha para ukta sādhana catuṣṭayasya pūrva vṛtta tvam nirasyati api ca iti mīmāṃsā iti ubhaya bhāga uktiḥ phalam bhukti muktī karaṇam yajña ādikam upāsanam ca iti kartavya tā prayāja ādikā sādhana saptakam ca bubhukṣuḥ mumukṣuḥ ca adhikārī

original: padārthaniścayādvākyārthaniścayavat tattadadhikaraṇādhīnaprātisvikārthaniścayāt puruṣārthatatsādhanasamudāyaniścaya iti bhidā sāṅgādhyayanādhīnanityānityāpātapratītiḥ svargāpavargasādhāraṇīti na sā'nyavirāgamumukṣutvahetuḥ | kāṇādādiśāstrāntaraṃ tu nityānityaviparītadhīheturviyatparamāṇvādinityādyukteḥ;
analyzed: padārtha niścayāt vākya artha niścaya vat tat tat adhikaraṇa adhīna prātisvika artha niścayāt puruṣa artha tad sādhana samudāya niścayaḥ iti bhidā sa aṅga adhyayana adhīna nitya anitya āpāta pratītiḥ svarga apavarga sādhāraṇī iti na sā anya virāga mumukṣu tva hetuḥ kāṇāda ādi śāstra antaram tu nitya anitya viparīta dhī hetuḥ viyat paramāṇu ādi nitya ādi ukteḥ

original: anavasaragrastaṃ ca puruṣasya prathamamadhyayanavidhigṛhītatvāt | purāṇādi ca śrutavedārthopabṛṃhaṇam; na svātantryeṇa nityādiniścāyakam | tathā sati tenaiva brahmasvarūpaniścayenaśārīrakavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | śamādi tu nirūpayiṣyate - śamadamādyupetaḥ syāt iti | ataḥ paścādbhāvino na pūrvavṛttatvamityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: anavasara grastam ca puruṣasya prathamam adhyayana vidhi gṛhīta tvāt purāṇa ādi ca śruta veda artha upabṛṃhaṇam na svātantryeṇa nitya ādi niścāyakam tathā sati tena eva brahma svarūpa niścayena śārīraka vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt śama ādi tu nirūpayiṣyate śama dama ādi upetaḥ syāt iti atas paścāt bhāvinaḥ na pūrva vṛtta tvam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ vyākhyeyavedasvabhāvāt karmabrahmamīmāṃsayoḥ paurvāparyamuktam | atha vyākhyānarūpamīmāṃsāsvabhāvācca karmacintāyāḥ pūrvavṛttatvamāha - eṣām iti | eṣāṃ - śamādīnām; viniyogaḥ - aṅgatvajñāpanam | tārtīyaḥ - tṛtīyādhyāyasiddhaḥ | idaṃ pradarśanārtham | tatra tatra pūrvakāṇḍoktakṛtsnanyāyasāpekṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: evam vyākhyeya veda svabhāvāt karma brahma mīmāṃsayoḥ paurvāparyam uktam atha vyākhyāna rūpa mīmāṃsā svabhāvāt ca karma cintāyāḥ pūrva vṛtta tvam āha eṣām iti eṣām śama ādīnām viniyogaḥ aṅgatva jñāpanam tārtīyaḥ tṛtīya adhyāya siddhaḥ idam pradarśana artham tatra tatra pūrva kāṇḍa ukta kṛtsna nyāya sāpekṣa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: athābhyuccayahetumāha - udgīthādi iti | samṛddhiḥ - apratibaddhaphalatvam | anyatarasyobhayorvā apekṣāvirahe'pi sādṛśyādinā dhīsthatvaṃ prāsaṅgikatvamiti tadvyudāsāya prathamamudgīthādidhiyo brahmacintāpekṣāmāha - brahmadṛṣṭi iti | brahmavidyāyā etadapekṣāmāha - tānyapi iti | tacchabdo vidyotpādakakarmaparaḥ | sutarām - ubhayāpekṣayetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atha abhyuccaya hetum āha udgītha ādi iti samṛddhiḥ apratibaddha phalatvam anyatarasya ubhayoḥ vā apekṣā virahe pi sādṛśya ādinā dhī sthatvam prāsaṅgika tvam iti tad vyudāsāya prathamam udgītha ādi dhiyaḥ brahma cintā apekṣām āha brahma dṛṣṭi iti brahmavidyāyāḥ etad apekṣām āha tāni api iti tad śabdaḥ vidyā utpādaka karma paraḥ sutarām ubhaya apekṣayā iti arthaḥ

original: karmāṅgāśrayatvāt pūrvatra brahmadṛṣṭirūpatvāduttaratra ca cintyatve prāpte karmasamṛddhyarthe ca sādhāraṇe'pi, pūrvatra brahmaṇo'cintitatvāt taddṛṣṭirūpodgīthādidhiyāṃ cintanaṃ tatrāśakyamityabhipretya ihaiva - ityuktam | astvevaṃ saṅgatiḥ, tathā'pi kimityatrāha - teṣām iti |
analyzed: karma aṅga āśraya tvāt pūrvatra brahma dṛṣṭi rūpa tvāt uttaratra ca cintya tve prāpte karma samṛddhi arthe ca sādhāraṇe pi pūrvatra brahmaṇā ucintita tvāt tad dṛṣṭi rūpa udgītha ādi dhiyām cintanam tatra aśakyam iti abhipretya iha eva iti uktam astu evam saṅgatiḥ tathā api kim iti atra āha teṣām iti

original: evamudgīthavidyāvicārasya sākṣātsaṅgatatvāt, tadapekṣitaṃ karmacintanaṃ pūrvavṛttamityabhyuccayahetuḥ | ekadeśādhyayanaṃ tvavaidham | kṛtsnādhyāyino'pi sukṛtavaśāduttaratraivāpekṣā cet, tatrāpi phalādhyāya eva sā kiṃ na syāt? tasya samanvayalakṣaṇādyapekṣā'sti cet, ihāpi pūrvabhāgacintāpekṣā tulyā |
analyzed: evam udgītha vidyā vicārasya sākṣāt saṅga tatvāt tad apekṣitam karma cintanam pūrva vṛttam iti abhyuccaya hetuḥ eka deśa adhyayanam tu avaidham kṛtsna adhyāyinaḥ api sukṛta vaśāt uttaratra eva apekṣā ced tatra api phala adhyāyaḥ eva sā kim na syāt tasya samanvaya lakṣaṇa ādi apekṣā asti ced iha api pūrvabhāga cintā apekṣā tulyā

original: āpātato'nantapratītistu pūrvatrāpi tulyetyuktam | ato'dhītakrameṇa karmavicāraprāthamyāt tannyāyasāpekṣatvāt brahmavicārasyodgīthādicintāpekṣitatvācca karmavicārasyaiva pūrvavṛttatvam ||
analyzed: āpātataḥ ananta pratītiḥ tu pūrvatra api tulyā iti uktam atas dhīta krameṇa karma vicāra prāthamyāt tad nyāya sāpekṣa tvāt brahma vicārasya udgītha ādi cintā apekṣita tvāt ca karma vicārasya eva pūrva vṛtta tvam

original: iti laghusiddhāntaḥ |
analyzed: iti laghu siddhāntaḥ

original: mahāpūrvapakṣaḥ |
analyzed: mahāpūrvapakṣaḥ

original: yadapyāhuḥ - aśeṣaviśeṣapratyanīkacinmātraṃ brahmaiva paramārthaḥ, tadatireki nānāvidhajñātṛjñeyatatkṛtajñānabhedādi sarvaṃ tasminneva parikalpitaṃ mithyābhūtam ... ... ... vastusvarūpopadeśaparaiḥ śāstreḥ nirviśeṣacinmātraṃ brahmaiva satyamanyatsarvaṃ mithyā ityabhidhānāt ||
analyzed: yat api āhuḥ aśeṣa viśeṣa pratyanīka cit mātram brahma eva paramārthaḥ tad atireki nānāvidha jñātṛ jñeya tad kṛta jñāna bheda ādi sarvam tasmin eva parikalpitam mithyā bhūtam vastu svarūpa upadeśa paraiḥ śāstreḥ nirviśeṣa cit mātram brahma eva satyam anyat sarvam mithyā iti abhidhānāt

original: evaṃ pūrvapakṣoktahetuṣu vastusāmarthyavyatiriktā hetavaḥ upāyaparavākyālocanayā parihṛtāḥ | vastusāmarthyaṃ tūpeyaparavākyaparyālocanayā vistareṇopanyasya pariharaṇīyamiti kṛtvā tat pūrvaṃ na parihṛtam | atastadvistareṇopanyasyate - yadapyāhuḥ ityādinā ... sarve vedāntā ārabhyante ityantena |
analyzed: evam pūrvapakṣa ukta hetuṣu vastu sāmarthya vyatiriktāḥ hetavaḥ upāya para vākya ālocanayā parihṛtāḥ vastu sāmarthyam tu upeya para vākya paryālocanayā vistareṇa upanyasya pariharaṇīyam iti kṛtvā tat pūrvam na parihṛtam atas tat vistareṇa upanyasyate yat api āhuḥ ityādinā sarve vedāntāḥ ārabhyante ityantena

original: yadapyāhuḥ iti apiśabdabahuvacanābhyāmasyārthasya prādhānyaṃ bahugranthakārābhimatiśca sūcite | cinmātrasatyatvamanyamithyātvaṃ ca pratijānīte - aśeṣa ityādigranthadvayena | aśeṣaviśeṣaḥ - jñātrādiḥ vyāvṛttirūpaśca | pratyanīkatvam - vastutastadanvayānarhatvam, jñātatvena tannivartakatvaṃ ca | citśabdena tucchatvaṃ vyudasyate |
analyzed: yat api āhuḥ iti apiśabda bahuvacanābhyām asya arthasya prādhānyam bahu granthakāra abhimatiḥ ca sūcite cit mātra satya tvam anya mithyātvam ca pratijānīte aśeṣaḥ ityādi grantha dvayena aśeṣa viśeṣaḥ jñātṛ ādiḥ vyāvṛtti rūpaḥ ca pratyanīka tvam vastutas tad anvaya anarha tvam jñāta tvena tad nivartaka tvam ca cit śabdena tuccha tvam vyudasyate

original: mātra cā jñātṛtvajñeyatve | eva iti | saguṇaṃ tu kālpanikamiti bhāvaḥ | cinmātrasatyatvaṃ pratijñātam; atha evakārābhipretaṃ samūlabandhadhīnivartyatvasiddhaye tadanyamithyātvamāha - tat iti | tadatireki - neha nānā ityādi niṣedhāstadanyaviṣayā iti bhāvaḥ | nānā śabdaviṣayaṃ darśayati - jñātṛ iti | tatkṛta iti svarūpaprayuktatāvyāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: jñātṛ tva jñeya tve eva iti saguṇam tu kālpanikam iti bhāvaḥ cit mātra satya tvam pratijñātam atha eva kāra abhipretam sa mūla bandha dhī nivartya tva siddhaye tad anya mithyātvam āha tat iti tad atireki na iha nānā ityādi niṣedhāḥ tad anya viṣayāḥ iti bhāvaḥ nānā śabda viṣayam darśayati jñātṛ iti tad kṛtaḥ iti svarūpa prayuktatā vyāvṛttiḥ

original: bhedaḥ tu avāntaravaividhyam | ādi śabdo janmajarāmaraṇādiparaḥ | sarvam iti | atadadhiṣṭhānaḥ paramārthaśca na kaścidartha ityarthaḥ | eva ityadhiṣṭhānānekatvavyudāsaḥ svaprakāśatvarūpavirodhaśaṅkāsphoraṇaṃ ca ||
analyzed: bhedaḥ tu avāntara vaividhyam ādi śabdaḥ janma jarā maraṇa ādi paraḥ sarvam iti a tad adhiṣṭhānaḥ paramārthaḥ ca na kaścid arthaḥ iti arthaḥ eva iti adhiṣṭhāna anekatva vyudāsaḥ sva prakāśa tva rūpa virodha śaṅkā sphoraṇam ca

original: pratijñātayormānamāha - sadeva ityādi | ṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgakaṃ kāraṇavākyaṃ vijātīyasajātīyasvagatabhedābhāvaparam sadeva iti | eva kārārthaspāṣṭyāya kāraṇavākyāntaramudāharati - atha parā iti | adreśyam agrāhyam -pratyakṣānumitya gocaraḥ, cakṣustadanyākṣāgocaro vā | gotram - nāma | sarvagatam - adhiṣṭhānatayā''śritam |
analyzed: pratijñātayoḥ mānam āha sa devaḥ ityādi ṣaḍvidha tātparya liṅgakam kāraṇa vākyam vijātīya sajātīya svagata bheda abhāva param sa devaḥ iti eva kārā artha spāṣṭyāya kāraṇa vākya antaram udāharati atha parāḥ iti adreśyam agrāhyam pratyakṣa anumitya gocaraḥ cakṣuḥ tad anya akṣa agocaraḥ vā gotram nāma sarva gatam adhiṣṭhānatayā āśritam

original: atha śodhakavākyam - satyam iti | kāraṇavākyaśodhakavākyāntaraikārthya sāmānādhikaraṇyairnirviśeṣaparatvamabhipretam | satyādivākyasya vyāvṛttiparatvaspāṣṭyāyāha - niṣkalam iti | kalāḥ - avayavāḥ | śāntam ityādi - ūrmiṣaṭkarahitamityarthaḥ | yasya iti - jñeyatvaniṣedhaḥ | na dṛṣṭeḥ iti jñātṛtvaniṣedhaḥ | asukhavyāvṛttiḥ ānandaḥ iti |
analyzed: atha śodhaka vākyam satyam iti kāraṇa vākya śodhaka vākya antara aikārthya sāmānādhikaraṇyaiḥ nirviśeṣa paratvam abhipretam satya ādi vākyasya vyāvṛtti paratva spāṣṭyāya āha niṣkalam iti kalāḥ avayavāḥ śāntam ityādi ūrmi ṣaṭka rahitam iti arthaḥ yasya iti jñeya tva niṣedhaḥ na dṛṣṭeḥ iti jñātṛ tva niṣedhaḥ asukha vyāvṛttiḥ ānandaḥ iti

original: atha cidanyamithyātvamāha - idaṃ sarvam ātmā iti | rajjureva sarpaḥ itivat bādhārthaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamabhipretam | tasminneva iti pratijñātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ ca sūcitam | bādhaṃ sphuṭayati - neha iti | bhedadṛgajña ityāha mṛtyoḥ iti | atra mṛtyuḥ - avidyā | tarhi kadācinnivṛttiḥ syādityatrāha - yatra hi iti | yatra -yadā;
analyzed: atha cit anya mithyātvam āha idam sarvam ātmā iti rajjuḥ eva sarpaḥ iti vat bādhā artham sāmānādhikaraṇyam abhipretam tasmin eva iti pratijñātam brahmaṇaḥ sarva adhyāsa adhiṣṭhāna tvam ca sūcitam bādham sphuṭayati na iha iti bheda dṛś ajñaḥ iti āha mṛtyoḥ iti atra mṛtyuḥ avidyā tarhi kadācid nivṛttiḥ syāt iti atra āha yatra hi iti yatra yadā

original: tat -tadā | itareṇa, kaḥ iti ca padadvayamadhyāhartavyam | dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati - vācā iti | uktamṛtyukāryabhedadhīphalaṃ darśayati - yadā iti | atha cinmātrasatyatvatadanyamithyātvaparaṃ sūtradvayam - na sthānataḥ ityādi ||
analyzed: tat tadā itareṇa kaḥ iti ca pada dvayam adhyāhartavyam dṛṣṭāntena upapādayati vācā iti ukta mṛtyu kārya bheda dhī phalam darśayati yadā iti atha cit mātra satya tva tad anya mithyātva param sūtra dvayam na sthānataḥ ityādi

original: atha purāṇoktimarthadvaye'pi darśayati - pratyastamita iti | pratyastamitabhedam - sajātīyavijātīyasvagatabhedarahitam | sattāmātram - vyāvṛttirūpabhedarahitam | tucchatāṃ vyudasyati - ātmasaṃvedyam iti | svaprakāśamityarthaḥ | tatra hetuḥ - jñānam iti | atyantanirmalam - nityāspṛṣṭaduḥkhitvajñātṛtvādibhedam | arthaḥ - devādiḥ |
analyzed: atha purāṇa uktim artha dvaye pi darśayati pratyastamitaḥ iti pratyastamita bhedam sajātīya vijātīya svagata bheda rahitam sattā mātram vyāvṛtti rūpa bheda rahitam tuccha tām vyudasyati ātma saṃvedyam iti sva prakāśam iti arthaḥ tatra hetuḥ jñānam iti atyanta nirmalam nitya a spṛṣṭa duḥkhi tva jñātṛ tva ādi bhedam arthaḥ deva ādiḥ

original: nānyo'sti iti jagadapāramārthyamuktam | tadvivaraṇāya yadetat iti ślokadvayam | uktabhramanivṛttiḥ tattvajñānena ityāha - ye tu iti | jīvaikyaprakaraṇamāha - tasya iti | ekamayam - ekam | ātma para śabdanimittātmabhedaśaṅkāṃ vyudasyati - yadi iti | nidarśayati - veṇu iti | upadiśati - soham iti | yathopadeśamanuṣṭhānam - tatyāja iti |
analyzed: na anyaḥ asti iti jagat apāramārthyam uktam tad vivaraṇāya yat etat iti śloka dvayam ukta bhrama nivṛttiḥ tattva jñānena iti āha ye tu iti jīva aikya prakaraṇam āha tasya iti eka mayam ekam ātma para śabda nimitta ātma bheda śaṅkām vyudasyati yadi iti nidarśayati veṇu iti upadiśati saḥ ham iti yathopadeśam anuṣṭhānam tatyāja iti

original: jīvabrahmabhedanivṛttiḥ - vibheda iti | arthadvaye'pi śrīgītoktiḥ - ahamātmā iti | bhūta śabdasya śarīramātraspāṣṭyāya āha - kṣetra iti | anyamithyātvam - na tadasti iti | ananyaparatvamuktam - vastusvarūpa iti ||
analyzed: jīva brahma bheda nivṛttiḥ vibhedaḥ iti artha dvaye api śrī gītā uktiḥ aham ātmā iti āha kṣetre iti anya mithyātvam na tat asti iti ananya paratvam uktam vastu svarūpe iti

original: mithyātvaṃ nāma pratīyamānatvapūrvakayathāvasthitavastujñānanivartyatvam ... ... ... doṣaśca svarūpatirodhānavicitravikṣepakarī sadasadanirvacanīyā'nādyavidyā||
analyzed: mithyātvam nāma pratīyamāna tva pūrvaka yathā avasthita vastu jñāna nivartya tvam doṣaḥ ca svarūpa tirodhāna vicitra vikṣepa karī sat asat anirvacanīya anādya vidyā

original: na atyantāsattvaṃ mithyātvam, khyāternirasanīyābhāvena śāstravaiyarthyaprasaṅgācca; na cānyatra sato'nyatra khyātatvam, kvā'pi satyatvaprasaṅgādityatrāha - mithyātvam iti |
analyzed: na atyanta asattvam mithyātvam khyāteḥ nirasanīya abhāvena śāstra vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt ca na ca anyatra sataḥ anyatra khyāta tvam kvāpi satya tva prasaṅgāt iti atra āha mithyātvam iti

original: pratīyamānatva ityasadvyāvṛttiḥ | yathāvasthita iti sadvyāvṛttiḥ | pratīyamānatvapūrvaka iti tanniyamapūrvakatvaṃ vivakṣitam | abbhakṣa itivat | jñānanivartyatvam iti - jñānamātranivartyatvam | vastuśabdaḥ karmadhārayaśaṅkāvyudāsāya |
analyzed: pratīyamāna tve iti asat vyāvṛttiḥ yathā avasthitaḥ iti sat vyāvṛttiḥ pratīyamāna tva pūrvakaḥ iti tad niyama pūrvaka tvam vivakṣitam abbhakṣaḥ iti vat jñāna nivartya tvam iti jñāna mātra nivartya tvam vastu śabdaḥ karmadhāraya śaṅkā vyudāsāya

original: evaṃ sati mudgarādinivartyaśaktyupabṛṃhita jñānanivartyabhrāntijñānanivartyasamyagrajatanivartakadhīprāgabhāvavyudāsaḥ | na ca bhūrandhradhīnivṛttarajjusarpe'tivyāptiḥ, tasyāpi yathā - vasthitarajjudhiyā nivartanārhatvāt | nidarśayati - yathā iti | nanu rajjvāderjaḍatvena svarūpānavabhāsādadhyāsaḥ;
analyzed: evam sati mudgara ādi nivartya śakti upabṛṃhita jñāna nivartya bhrānti jñāna nivartya samyak rajata nivartaka dhī prāgabhāva vyudāsaḥ na ca bhū randhra dhī nivṛtta rajju sarpa iti vyāptiḥ tasya api yathā vasthita rajju dhiyā nivartana arha tvāt nidarśayati yathā iti nanu rajju ādeḥ jaḍa tvena svarūpa anavabhāsāt adhyāsaḥ

original: svaprakāśavastuni tu sa kathamityatrāha - doṣa iti | doṣa evādhyāsaprayojakaḥ, svato vā parato vā bhānaṃ tattvadhyāsopayogi adhiṣṭhāne bhāte'pi hi saḥ iti bhāvaḥ | mithyālakṣaṇaṃ tasya doṣakalpitatvaṃ ca dṛṣṭānte darśitaṃ dārṣṭāntike'tidiśan śaṅkādvayaṃ ca śamayati - evam iti | kathamekatra bahvadhyāsa iti śaṅkāṃ vyudasyati - para iti |
analyzed: sva prakāśa vastuni tu sa katham iti atra āha doṣaḥ iti doṣaḥ eva adhyāsa prayojakaḥ svatas vā paratas vā bhānam tattva dhyāsa upayogi adhiṣṭhāne hi saḥ iti bhāvaḥ mithyā lakṣaṇam tasya doṣa kalpita tvam ca dṛṣṭānte darśitam dārṣṭāntika itidiśan śaṅkā dvayam ca śamayati evam iti katham ekatra bahu adhyāsaḥ iti śaṅkām vyudasyati paraḥ iti

original: adhiṣṭhānavailakṣaṇyāt rajjau sarpabhūrandhrādivaditi bhāvaḥ | sarvajñe kathaṃ bhrāntiriti ca śaṅkāṃ vyudasyati - para iti | sarvajñatvādayaḥ saguṇabrahmaṇaḥ, na tu parasyetyarthaḥ | doṣa ityādipadaiḥ prāguktārthadvayātideśaḥ | idaṃ - pratīyamānam | nānāvidhatvavivaraṇam deva ityādipadam ||
analyzed: adhiṣṭhāna vailakṣaṇyāt rajjau sarpa bhū randhra ādi vat iti bhāvaḥ sarvajñe katham bhrāntiḥ iti ca śaṅkām vyudasyati paraḥ iti sarvajñatva ādayaḥ saguṇa brahmaṇaḥ na tu parasya iti arthaḥ doṣaḥ ityādi padaiḥ prāgukta artha dvaya atideśaḥ idam pratīyamānam nānāvidha tva vivaraṇam devaḥ ityādi padam

original: doṣaḥ kaḥ? sa satyaścenna dhīnivartyaḥ; na ceddoṣāntarāpekṣayā anavasthā | sa cet brahmaṇyatirohite kalpyate, bhramānudayānucchedayoranyataraḥ syāt | tirohite cet; yadi tirodhiḥ svataḥ, anivṛttiḥ svarūpanivṛttirvā syāt | parataścedanavasthā | nānādhyāsā nānādoṣamūlāśca dṛṣṭā iti bahuśaṅkāparihārāyāha - doṣaśca iti |
analyzed: doṣaḥ kaḥ sa satyaḥ ced na dhī nivartyaḥ na ced doṣa antara apekṣayā anavasthā sa ced brahmaṇi atirohite kalpyate bhrama anudaya anucchedayoḥ anyataraḥ syāt tirohite ced yadi tirodhiḥ svatas anivṛttiḥ svarūpa nivṛttiḥ vā syāt paratas ced anavasthā nānā adhyāsāḥ nānā doṣa mūlāḥ ca dṛṣṭāḥ iti bahu śaṅkā parihārāya āha doṣaḥ ca iti

original: avidyā iti, sadasadanirvacanīya iti, anādi iti, svarūpatirodhānavividhavicitravikṣepakarī iti śabdairimāḥ śaṅkāḥ pratyuktāḥ ||
analyzed: avidyā iti sat asat anirvacanīyaḥ iti anādi iti svarūpa tirodhāna vividha vicitra vikṣepa karī iti śabdaiḥ imāḥ śaṅkāḥ pratyuktāḥ

original: anṛtena hi pratyūḍhāḥ teṣāṃ satyānāṃ satāmanṛtamapidhānam ... ... ... ... brahmaivānādyavidyayā sadasadanirvācyayā tirohitasvarūpaṃ svagatanānātvaṃ paśyatītyavagamyate ||
analyzed: anṛtena hi pratyūḍhāḥ teṣām satyānām satām anṛtam apidhānam brahma eva anādya vidyayā sat asat anirvācyayā tirohita svarūpam svagata nānātvam paśyati iti avagamyate

original: evaṃvidhāvidyāyāṃ mānamāha - anṛtena ityādinā | pratyūḍhāḥ - pratibaddhāḥ | pratyūḍhaśabdavivaraṇāyāha - teṣām iti | bahuvacanam aditiḥ pāśān itivat | nāsadāsīt ityanirvacanīyatvam | tamo hi sūkṣmāvasthaprakṛtiḥ, na tu mithyārūpāvidyetyatrāha - māyāṃ tu iti | bahubhramahetutvamāha - indra iti | dhiyā vinā durnirasatvamāha - mama iti |
analyzed: evaṃvidha avidyāyām mānam āha anṛtena ityādinā pratyūḍhāḥ pratibaddhāḥ pratyūḍha śabda vivaraṇāya āha teṣām iti bahuvacanam aditiḥ pāśān iti vat na asat āsīt iti anirvacanīya tvam tamaḥ hi sūkṣma avastha prakṛtiḥ na tu mithyā rūpā avidyā iti atra āha māyām tu iti bahu bhrama hetutvam āha indraḥ iti dhiyā vinā durnirasa tvam āha mama iti

original: anāditvamāha - anādi iti | ādi śabdaḥ prāguktasvarūpaparaśrutismṛtigaṇaparaḥ | indramaheśvarādi śabdaiḥ saviśeṣatvaśaṅkāṃ nirasyan vākyānāmarthamāha - nirviśeṣa iti | svarūpaparavākyaikārthyāt doṣaparavākyeṣvapi nirviśeṣaṃ vastu doṣāśrayatayā vivakṣitamityarthaḥ | svagata iti adhiṣṭhānabhūtena svena saṃbandhamavagamyate | yata iti pūraṇam ||
analyzed: anādi tvam āha anādi iti ādi śabdaḥ prāgukta svarūpa para śruti smṛti gaṇa paraḥ indra maheśvara ādi śabdaiḥ saviśeṣa tva śaṅkām nirasyan vākyānām artham āha nirviśeṣaḥ iti svarūpa para vākya aikārthyāt doṣa para vākyeṣu api nirviśeṣam vastu doṣa āśraya tayā vivakṣitam iti arthaḥ svagataḥ iti adhiṣṭhāna bhūtena svena saṃbandham avagamyate yatas iti pūraṇam

original: yathoktaḥ - jñānasvarūpo bhagavān yato'sāvāśeṣamūrtirna tu vastubhūtaḥ | ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...| etattu yatsaṃvyavahārabhūtaṃ tatrāpi coktaṃ bhuvanāśritaṃ te || iti ||
analyzed: yathā uktaḥ jñāna sva rūpaḥ bhagavān yatas asau āśeṣa mūrtiḥ na tu vastu bhūtaḥ etat tu yat saṃvyavahāra bhūtam tatra api ca uktam bhuvana āśritam te iti

original: svarūpaparairiva vākyairnirviśeṣaṃ vastu doṣāśrayatayā doṣaparasmṛtyā apijñāyate ityāha - yathā iti | vastu śabdo vakṣyamāṇadevādiparaḥ | vividhaṃjñāyate'neneti vijñānam avidyā | bhedadarśanasyājñānakāryatvaṃ vyatirekeṇa vivṛṇoti - yadā iti | śuddham nijarūpi - avidyākṛtabhedadarśanarahitam | samantāt kalpyante bhedā anenetyavidyā - saṅkalpaḥ |
analyzed: svarūpa paraiḥ iva vākyaiḥ nirviśeṣam vastu doṣa āśraya tayā doṣa para smṛtyā apijñāyate iti āha yathā iti vastu śabdaḥ vakṣyamāṇa deva ādi paraḥ vividham jñāyate nena iti vijñānam avidyā bheda darśanasya ajñāna kārya tvam vyatirekeṇa vivṛṇoti yadā iti śuddham nija rūpi avidyā kṛta bheda darśana rahitam samantāt kalpyante bhedāḥ anena iti avidyā saṅkalpaḥ

original: avidyātarusaṃbhūtiḥ iti vakṣyate | vastuṣu - devādidharmiṣu | vastubhedāḥ - devādyākārabhedāḥ | vastvasti ityādiślokadvayaṃ siddhānte vakṣyate | vijātīyabhedaniṣedhamupasaṃharati - tasmāt iti | sajātīyabhedaṃ niṣedhati - vijñānam iti | svagatamapi niṣedhati - jñānam iti | viśuddhaṃ vimalam avidyābhedaddaṣṭirahitam | sadaikam vṛddhyādirahitam |
analyzed: avidyā taru saṃbhūtiḥ iti vakṣyate vastuṣu deva ādi dharmiṣu vastu bhedāḥ deva ādi ākāra bhedāḥ vastu asti ityādi śloka dvayam siddhānte vakṣyate vijātīya bheda niṣedham upasaṃharati tasmāt iti sajātīya bhedam niṣedhati vijñānam iti svagatam api niṣedhati jñānam iti viśuddham vimalam avidyā bheda ddaṣṭi rahitam sadā ekam vṛddhi ādi rahitam

original: nedaṃ paramatamityāha - sat iti | etat - jñānam; bhuvanāśritam - bhuvanenādhiṣṭhānatayā''śritam | saṃvyavahārabhūtam - samantāt vyavahārāspadaṃ vartata iti yat, tatra heturavidyetyukta ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na idam para matam iti āha sat iti etat jñānam bhuvana āśritam bhuvanena adhiṣṭhāna tayā āśritam saṃvyavahāra bhūtam samantāt vyavahāra āspadam vartate iti yat tatra hetuḥ avidyā iti uktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: asyāścāvidyāyā nirviśeṣacinmātrabrahmātmaikatvavijñānena nivṛtiṃta vadanti ... ... anena ca brahmātmaikatvavijñānena mithyārūpasya sakāraṇasya bandhasya nivṛttiryuktā||
analyzed: asyāḥ ca avidyāyāḥ nirviśeṣa cit mātra brahma ātma eka tva vijñānena vadanti anena ca brahma ātma eka tva vijñānena mithyārūpasya sa kāraṇasya bandhasya nivṛttiḥ yuktā

original: tataḥ kiṃ jñānasya karmanairapekṣya ityatrāha - asyāśca iti | ajñānanivṛtiṃta darśayituṃ na punaḥ iti vākyamupāttam | jñānasyaikyaviṣayatvāya tadekam iti | tathā satyabhayaprāptyai yadā iti | ātmyam -śarīram | niruktiḥ - nāma | abhayam - bhayābhāvāya; avyayībhāvasamāsaḥ | bandhakatvena parābhimatasyāpi jñānena nivartyatvāyā''ha - bhidyata iti |
analyzed: tatas kim jñānasya karma nairapekṣye iti atra āha asyāḥ ca iti darśayitum na punar iti vākyam upāttam jñānasya aikya viṣaya tvāya tat ekam iti tathā satya bhaya prāptyai yadā iti ātmyam śarīram niruktiḥ nāma abhayam bhaya abhāvāya avyayībhāva samāsaḥ bandhaka tvena para abhimatasya api jñānena nivartya tvāya āha bhidyate iti

original: atra bhedapratītivyudāsāyāha - brahma iti | upāyāntaraniṣedhamāha - tameva iti |
analyzed: atra bheda pratīti vyudāsāya āha brahma iti upāya antara niṣedham āha tam eva iti

original: nātrājñānanivṛttiḥ pratītetyatrāha - atra iti | kathamityatrāha - yathā iti | pramādam iti -anavadhānam, taddheturavidyetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: na atra ajñāna nivṛttiḥ pratītā iti atra āha atra iti katham iti atra āha yathā iti pramādam iti anavadhānam tad hetuḥ avidyā iti arthaḥ

original: nirviśeṣabrahmātmaikyaviṣayatvaṃ nāvagatamityatrāha - satyam iti | nirviśeṣatvaṃ śodhakasiddham | tena ātmana aikyaṃ śrāvayati - athayo'nyām iti | bhedadhīrniṣiddhā; athopadeśaṃ darśayati - tattvam iti | tathā devatāṃ pratyāha - tvaṃ vā iti | svasminnanusandhatte -- tadyoham iti | asya sautratāmāha - vakṣyati iti |
analyzed: nirviśeṣa brahma ātma aikya viṣayatvam na avagatam iti atra āha satyam iti nirviśeṣa tvam śodhaka siddham tena ātmanaḥ aikyam śrāvayati atha yonyām iti bheda dhīḥ niṣiddhā atha upadeśam darśayati tattvam iti tathā devatām pratyāha tvam vā iti svasmin anusandhatte tad yaḥ aham iti asya sautra tām āha vakṣyati iti

original: tadabhiprāyajñoktimāha - tathā ca iti | tanniṣpatteḥ - tasmin kalpitatvāt | mānānugrāhakaṃ darśayati - anena ca iti | mithyārūpasya iti hetugarbham | sakāraṇasya -sāvidyasya | sarpabhramo hi rajjujñānena nivartyaḥ, na karmaṇeti bhāvaḥ ||

original: dvayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ iti | dvayoḥ pratyakṣayoḥ, pratyakṣānumānayoḥ, anumānayoḥ pratyakṣāgamayoḥ, anumānāgamayoḥ, āgamayorvetyarthaḥ | ananyathāsiddhatvam - viruddhaviṣayamānābādhenānudayatvam; tacca viṣayāntarālābhāpramāṇakoṭiniveśābhāvarūpāt anavakāśatvāt | sarvatra - pratyakṣādiṣu sajātīyayorvijātīyayoḥ virodhe ityarthaḥ |

original: iti etaduktam ityanvayaḥ ||

original: tataḥ kiṃ śāstraprābalyasya ityatrāha - tasmāt iti | anādinidhanā hyeṣā iti smṛtiḥ apauruṣeyatvasādhakaliṅgaṃ ca smāritam anādi ityādinā | yato doṣāsaṃbhāvanā, tato'pramāṇakoṭyaniveśaḥ | arthavirodhaṃ darśayati - nirviśeṣa ityādinā | śuddhiḥ - avidyāvirahaḥ | tataḥ muktam - avidyākāryabandharahitam | buddham - bhāsamānam; tacca svataḥ |
analyzed: tatas kim śāstra prābalyasya iti atra āha tasmāt iti anādinidhanā hi eṣā iti smṛtiḥ apauruṣeya tva sādhaka liṅgam ca smāritam anādi ityādinā yatas doṣa asaṃbhāvanā artha virodham darśayati nirviśeṣaḥ ityādinā śuddhiḥ avidyā virahaḥ tatas muktam avidyā kārya bandha rahitam buddham bhāsamānam tat ca svatas

original: tacca cidrūpatayā śrutatvāditi padārthaḥ | vividhavikalparūpo bandhaḥ | kaśca doṣa ityatrāha - saṃbhāvyate ca iti | bhedaprapañcaḥ - bhedasamudāyaḥ jñātrādiḥ; sa ca devādirūpeṇa vividhaḥ | sa ca brāhmaṇādirūpeṇa vikalpavāniti vividhavikalpabhedarūpaḥ | ādi śabdena bhedadarśanamuktam | tayoranyonyāśrayavyudāsāya anādi śabdaḥ |
analyzed: tat ca cit rūpa tayā śruta tvāt iti padārthaḥ vividha vikalpa rūpaḥ bandhaḥ kaḥ ca doṣaḥ iti atra āha saṃbhāvyate ca iti bheda prapañcaḥ bheda samudāyaḥ jñātṛ ādiḥ sa ca deva ādi rūpeṇa vividhaḥ sa ca brāhmaṇa ādi rūpeṇa vikalpavān iti vividha vikalpa bheda rūpaḥ ādi śabdena bheda darśanam uktam tayoḥ anyonya āśraya vyudāsāya anādi śabdaḥ

original: bījāṅkuravat pravāhānādiḥ | kācādivyudāsāya avidyākhya śabdaḥ | kvācitkena kācādinā sarvatra doṣānumāne, vākyatvāt vede'pi prasajet | yogyānupalabdhistu tulyeti bhāvaḥ | ādi śabdaḥ kāraṇāvidyāviṣayo vā ||

original: codayati - nanu iti | anantaroktabādhyatvaprayojakābhāvamāha - anādi iti | apiḥ virodhe | bādhyabādhakatābhyupagamanimittaṃ virodhaṃ darśayati - jyotiṣṭomena iti | bādhyatvamaṅgīkurvan dṛṣṭahetukatvamanupagacchan pariharati - satyam iti | sāvakāśatvānavakāśatvāvāntaravidhārūpeṇa paurvāparyeṇa nirvāhaḥ |
