original: udgātṛpratihartrapacchedayornaimittikatvenādakṣiṇasaṃsthāpanasarvasvadakṣiṇatve vihite | ekaprayoge tayorvirodhaḥ; tatra yaugapadye vikalpaḥ; paurvāparye tu pūrvaprābalyam asañjātavirodhitayodayāt, parasya sapratipakṣatayaivodayācca iti pūrvapakṣitam | virodhyasannidhānāt tadabādhena pūrvasyodayasaṃbhavaḥ;
analyzed: udgātṛ pratihartṛ apacchedayoḥ naimittika tvena adakṣiṇa saṃsthāpana sarva sva dakṣiṇa tve vihite eka prayoge tayoḥ virodhaḥ tatra yaugapadye vikalpaḥ paurvāparye tu pūrva prābalyam asañjāta virodhi tayā udayāt parasya sa pratipakṣa tayā eva udayāt ca iti pūrva pakṣitam virodhya sannidhānāt tad abādhena pūrvasya udaya saṃbhavaḥ

original: uttarasya tu sannihitavirodhyabādhenodayāsaṃbhavāt, bādhitvaivodaya iti prābalyam; nimittodayānnaimittikaśāstraṃ coditameveti siddhāntitam | taduktam pūrvābādhena notpattiruttarasya hi sidhyati iti | pāṭhakramāt trivarge saṃsāriṇāṃ prathamaprāvaṇyarūpārthakramācca paurvāparyasiddhiriti tena nyāyena pūrvabādha ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: uttarasya tu sannihita virodhya bādhena udaya asaṃbhavāt bādhitvā eva udayaḥ iti prābalyam nimitta udayāt naimittika śāstram coditam eva iti siddhāntitam tat uktam pūrva ābādhena nā utpattiḥ uttarasya hi sidhyati iti pāṭha kramāt trivarge saṃsāriṇām prathama prāvaṇya rūpa artha kramāt ca paurvāparya siddhiḥ iti tena nyāyena pūrva bādhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tādṛśapaurvāparyābhāvāt saguṇopāstiśāstreṣu nāyaṃ nirvāha ityatrāha - vedānta iti | kuta ityatrāha - nirguṇatvāt iti | apacchedanyāyaphalarūpabādhadarśanādityarthaḥ | saguṇopāsanasya jakṣaṇādisāṃsārikaphalaśravaṇāt pūrvatvamabhipraiti | svarūpa parasaguṇavākyeṣu kathamiti codayati - nanu ca iti | pariharati - nirguṇa iti |
analyzed: tādṛśa paurvāparya abhāvāt saguṇa upāsti śāstreṣu nā ayam nirvāhaḥ iti atra āha vedānte iti kutas iti atra āha nirguṇa tvāt iti apaccheda nyāya phala rūpa bādha darśanāt iti arthaḥ saguṇa upāsanasya jakṣaṇa ādi sāṃsārika phala śravaṇāt pūrvatvam abhipraiti svarūpa para saguṇa vākyeṣu katham iti codayati nanu ca iti pariharati nirguṇaḥ iti

original: kāni nirguṇavākyāni, kathaṃ ca teṣāṃ sāmarthyamityatrāha - etaduktam iti | kūṭastham - nirvikāram | itarāṇi - yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādīni | guṇāpekṣatvena - niṣedhasya prasañjakasāpekṣatvādityarthaḥ | na kiñcidapahīnam - upāsanārthatvāt saguṇavākyānām na vaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kāni nirguṇa vākyāni katham ca teṣām sāmarthyam iti atra āha etat uktam iti kūṭastham nirvikāram itarāṇi yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādīni guṇa apekṣa tvena niṣedhasya prasañjaka sāpekṣa tvāt iti arthaḥ na kiñcid apahīnam upāsana artha tvāt saguṇa vākyānām na vaiyarthyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadvā - yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityāderapyupāsanārthatvaṃ vivakṣannāha - vedānta iti | paurvāparyābhāvānna guṇabādhaḥ | tata eva nopāsanārthatvaklṛptiḥ iti codayati - nanu ca iti | vidhiniṣedharūpapaurvāparyamabhipretya pariharati - nirguṇa iti | sarvamanyat pūrvavat ||
analyzed: yat vā yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādeḥ api upāsana arthatvam vivakṣan āha vedānte iti paurvāparya abhāvāt na guṇa bādhaḥ tatas eva na upāsana arthatva klṛptiḥ iti codayati nanu ca iti vidhi niṣedha rūpa paurvāparyam abhipretya pariharati nirguṇaḥ iti sarvam anyat pūrvavat

original: nanu ca - satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma ityatra satyajñānādayo guṇāḥ pratīyante | netyucyate, ... ... ... ... ... evamekasyaiva vastunaḥ sakaletaravirodhyākāratāmavagamayadarthavattaramekārthamaparyāyaṃ ca padatnayam ||

original: nirguṇaparatayopāttaṃ satyādivākyaṃ saguṇaparaṃ buddhvā codayati - nanu ca iti | satyajñānādayaḥ - satyatvajñānatvādayaḥ | dvyekayoḥ itivat dvitvaikatvayoriti hyarthaḥ | anyathā dvyekeṣu iti bahuvacanaprasaṅgāt | pariharati - neti iti | pratītiḥ āpātadhīścenna naḥ kṣatiḥ, pramitiścennetyupapādayiṣyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nirguṇa para tayā upāttam satya ādi vākyam sa guṇa param buddhvā codayati nanu ca iti satya jñāna ādayaḥ satya tva jñāna tva ādayaḥ dvi ekayoḥ iti vat dvi tva ekatvayoḥ iti hi arthaḥ anyathā dvi ekeṣu iti bahuvacana prasaṅgāt pariharati na iti iti pratītiḥ āpāta dhīḥ ced na naḥ kṣatiḥ pramitiḥ ced na iti upapādayiṣyate iti arthaḥ

original: kuta ityatrāha - sāmānādhikaraṇyena iti | śaṅkate - aneka iti | vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣviva na padārthānekatvaṃ vākyārthaikatvavirodhīti bhāvaḥ | samānādhikaraṇavyadhikaraṇavākyayorabhidhānaviśeṣānabhijña ityupālabhya pariharati - anabhidhāna iti | devānāṃ priyaḥ - chāgaḥ, ajñaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | kathamityatrāha - ekārthatvam iti |
analyzed: kutas iti atra āha sāmānādhikaraṇyena iti śaṅkate anekaḥ iti vyadhikaraṇa vākyeṣu iva na padārtha aneka tvam vākya artha eka tva virodhi iti bhāvaḥ samāna adhikaraṇa vyadhikaraṇa vākyayoḥ abhidhāna viśeṣa anabhijñaḥ iti upālabhya pariharati anabhidhānaḥ iti devānām priyaḥ chāgaḥ ajñaḥ iti bhāvaḥ katham iti atra āha ekārtha tvam iti

original: na tu pṛthagarthapadasamudāyabodhyapradhānārthaikatvam, tattu vyadhikaraṇavākyeṣviti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kimityatrāha - viśiṣṭa iti | samānādhikaraṇavākyasthaprātipadikāni kiṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparāṇi, uta viśiṣṭaparāṇi, uta svarūpamātraparāṇi iti vikalpamabhipretya, prathame viśeṣaṇarūpārthānekatvānnārthaikyam; dvitīye'pi tat tulyam |
analyzed: na tu pṛthak artha pada samudāya bodhya pradhāna artha ekatvam tat tu vyadhikaraṇa vākyeṣu iti bhāvaḥ tatas kim iti atra āha viśiṣṭe iti samāna adhikaraṇa vākya stha prātipadikāni kim viśeṣaṇa mātra parāṇi uta viśiṣṭa parāṇi uta svarūpa mātra parāṇi iti vikalpam abhipretya prathame viśeṣaṇa rūpa artha anekatvāt na artha aikyam dvitīye api tat tulyam

original: kiñca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya rūpārthabhedācca nārthaikyam | viśeṣaṇabhedena viśeṣyabhedaprasaṅgācca | viśeṣaṇaṃ hi bhedakam | devadattaḥ śyāmo yuvā ityādau pratyakṣabalādaikyam | brahma tu na tadgocaram |
analyzed: kiñca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya rūpa artha bhedāt ca na artha aikyam viśeṣaṇa bhedena viśeṣya bheda prasaṅgāt ca viśeṣaṇam hi bhedakam devadattaḥ śyāmaḥ yuvā ityādau pratyakṣa balāt aikyam brahma tu na tad gocaram

original: na ca ekavacanāntadharmivācipadaikyāt viśeṣyaikyam, khaṇḍo muṇḍaḥ pūrṇaśrṛṅgo gauḥ ityatrādṛṣṭeḥ tadvahutvaṃ pratyakṣabalāt iti cet na, apratyakṣagorapi puruṣasyānena vākyena gobahutvapratīteḥ | tasmādapratyakṣe brahmaṇi viśeṣaṇabhedaprayuktaviśeṣyabhedo durvāra ityādidūṣaṇāni viśeṣaṇabhedena ityādigranthenoktāni |
analyzed: na ca ekavacana anta dharmi vāci pada aikyāt viśeṣya aikyam khaṇḍaḥ muṇḍaḥ pūrṇa śrṛṅgaḥ gauḥ iti atra adṛṣṭeḥ tad vahu tvam pratyakṣa balāt iti ced na apratyakṣa goḥ api puruṣasya anena vākyena go bahu tva pratīteḥ tasmāt apratyakṣe brahmaṇi viśeṣaṇa bheda prayukta viśeṣya bhedaḥ durvāraḥ ityādi dūṣaṇāni viśeṣaṇa bhedena ityādi granthena uktāni

original: artha śabdo viśeṣyasyāpi vācakaḥ | krameṇābhidhānaṃ cet viśeṣya iva viśeṣaṇe'pi padāntaravihita viśeṣaṇānvayāt viśeṣaṇayormithaḥ samavāyaḥ | yugapaccet samānavibhaktyā viśeṣyāṃśa iva viśeṣaṇe'pyaikyapratipādanāt viśeṣaṇaikyam uddeśyopādeyavibhāgābhāvaśca ityādidūṣaṇānyanyatroktāni ihābhipretāni | tataḥ kimityatrāha - tataśca iti |

original: śirodvayadūṣaṇāt tṛtīyaśiro'rthāt svīkṛtam | tadvivṛṇvaṃścodayati - evam iti | evaṃ tarhi - vastumātraparatve | ekatarapadavaiyarthyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇahāniścābhiprete, parihariṣyamāṇatvāt | idaṃ bahugranthaiḥ parihartuṃ madhye tvarayā na codanīyamityabhiprāyeṇāha - ekārtha iti | ekārthābhidhāyitve'pi iti codya hetvanuvādaḥ |

original: pariharati ekatva iti | tātparyaniścayaḥ samānavibhaktyā | lakṣaṇahāniparihāraḥ caśabdābhipretaḥ | arthavatvam - prayojanavattvam | bahuvyāvartyavyudasanāt arthavattvam | pravṛttinimittabhūtaistaiḥ aparyāyatā, sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇānurodhaśca ekārthatvāvirodhena sidhyantītyuktaṃ bhavati ||

original: tat tvaṃ padayorivānvayamukhenopalakṣaṇadvārā svarūpaparatvaṃ kiṃ na syāt? vyāvṛttibahutvānnaikārthatvaṃ, vyāvartyānantyānna tadvyudāsaḥ katipayapadaiḥ śakyate; yebhyo vyāvṛttiḥ, kāni ca tāni? vyāvṛttibhiḥ sadharmakatvam | vyāvṛttayo na dharmāścet paryāyatā syādityāśaṃkyāha - etaduktam iti |
analyzed: tat tvam padayoḥ iva anvaya mukhena upalakṣaṇa dvārā svarūpa paratvam kim na syāt vyāvṛtti bahutvāt na ekārtha tvam vyāvartya ānantyāt na tad vyudāsaḥ katipaya padaiḥ śakyate yebhyaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ kāni ca tāni vyāvṛttibhiḥ sadharmaka tvam vyāvṛttayaḥ na dharmāḥ ced paryāyatā syāt iti āśaṃkya āha etat uktam iti

original: kāraṇatayoktasya śaṅkitadoṣavyudāsasyāpekṣitatvāt tadvyāvṛttimukhena svarūpaparatvamabhipretya lakṣaṇataḥ ityādyuktam | sarvamanena padatrayeṇa phalataḥ iti | prayojakena rūpeṇānantavyāvartyavyudāsaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | vyudāsastu phalitaḥ | padāni tu svarūpapāṇītyekārthatvaṃ cābhipretam | kena kasmāt vyāvṛttirityatrāha - tatra iti |
analyzed: kāraṇatayā uktasya śaṅkita doṣa vyudāsasya apekṣita tvāt tad vyāvṛtti mukhena svarūpa paratvam abhipretya lakṣaṇataḥ ityādi uktam sarvam anena pada trayeṇa phalataḥ iti prayojakena rūpeṇa ananta vyāvartya vyudāsaḥ iti bhāvaḥ vyudāsaḥ tu phalitaḥ padāni tu svarūpa pāṇi iti ekārtha tvam ca abhipretam kena kasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ iti atra āha tatra iti

original: kāraṇatayaiva tucchatvavyāvṛttervikārivyāvṛttiruktā | jaḍarūpa ityasya vyākhyānam anyādhīnaprakāśa iti | tābhiḥ sadharmakatvamityatrāha - na ca iti | vādiviśeṣāpekṣayā bhāvābhāvarūpatoktiḥ | tarhi kimityatrāha - api tu iti | nidarśayati - yathā iti | na dharmāntaram iti | anupalambhāt, tadabhyupagame'navasthānācceti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kāraṇatayā eva tuccha tva vyāvṛtteḥ vikāri vyāvṛttiḥ uktā jaḍa rūpaḥ iti asya vyākhyānam anya adhīna prakāśaḥ iti tābhiḥ sadharmaka tvam iti atra āha na ca iti vādi viśeṣa apekṣayā bhāva abhāva rūpatā uktiḥ tarhi kim iti atra āha api tu iti nidarśayati yathā iti na dharma antaram iti anupalambhāt tad abhyupagamena avasthānāt ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: tarhi paryāyatā syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ, śauklyaṃ kāṣrṇyavyāvṛttaṃ pītimavyāvṛttamityādipratibandyabhiprāyeṇāha - ekasyaiva iti | arthavattaram -dṛṣṭāntāpekṣayā parābhimatasaguṇaparatvāpekṣayā ca | śauklyaṃ hi pratyakṣam | ato vākyaṃ mandaprayojanam | śodhakasya śaṅkitadoṣavyudāso hi kṛtyam, na tu guṇānvayajñāpanamiti ||
analyzed: tarhi paryāya tā syāt iti śaṅkāyām śauklyam kāṣrṇya vyāvṛttam pītima vyāvṛttam ityādi pratibandi abhiprāyeṇa āha ekasya eva iti arthavattaram dṛṣṭānta apekṣayā para abhimata saguṇa paratva apekṣayā ca śauklyam hi pratyakṣam atas vākyam manda prayojanam śodhakasya śaṅkita doṣa vyudāsaḥ hi kṛtyam na tu guṇa anvaya jñāpanam iti

original: prathamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: prathama adhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

original: prathame pāde adhītavedaḥ puruṣaḥ karmamīmāṃsā ... spaṣṭaliṅgakāni tṛtīye; tattatpratipādanacchāyānusārīṇi caturthe||
analyzed: prathame pāde adhīta vedaḥ puruṣaḥ karma mīmāṃsā spaṣṭa liṅgakāni tṛtīye tad tad pratipādana chāyā anusārīṇi caturthe

original: pratyadhikāraṇamanugatasya prathamapādarthasya tripādīsaṅgatyarthaṃ buddhisthatvāya tri pādīsūtraviṣayabhūtavākyānāṃ prāguktanyāyāviṣayatayā tasyā ārambhaṇīyatvasiddhaye ca prathamapādādhikaraṇārthānukramaḥ | śāstrārambhasiddhyarthāyāḥ catusmūtryā arthāt prathamapāde saṅgatiḥ |
analyzed: prati adhika araṇam anugatasya prathama pāda arthasya tripādī saṅgati artham buddhi stha tvāya tri pādī sūtra viṣaya bhūta vākyānām prāgukta nyāya aviṣaya tayā tasyāḥ ārambhaṇīya tva siddhaye ca prathama pāda adhikaraṇa artha anukramaḥ śāstra ārambha siddhi arthāyāḥ catusmūtryāḥ arthāt prathama pāde saṅgatiḥ

original: janamādi trisūtryāḥ prathamādhīnāraṃbhātvāt prāthamikārthānukrame śāstrāraṃbhasiddhaye ityuktam | janmādi trisūtryāḥ prathamapāde viśeṣasaṅgatiścāsti, cidacidvilakṣaṇavastulakṣaṇajanmādiparatvāt | cidacidvilakṣaṇavastumadbhāvo hi prathamapādārthaḥ | śāstrāraṃbha iti paramutaratrānuṣaṅgeṇa catussūtryarthaṃ vā ||
analyzed: tri sūtryāḥ prathama adhīna āraṃbhā tvāt prāthamika artha anukrame śāstra āraṃbha siddhaye iti uktam janma ādi tri sūtryāḥ prathama pāde viśeṣa saṅgatiḥ ca asti cit acit vilakṣaṇa vastu lakṣaṇa janma ādi paratvāt cit acit vilakṣaṇa vastumat bhāvaḥ hi prathama pāda arthaḥ śāstra āraṃbhe iti param utaratra anuṣaṅgeṇa catur sūtrī artham vā

original: prathamādhikaraṇārthamāha - adhīta iti | janmādyadhikaraṇārthamāha ananta iti| mahānandaikakāraṇam iti tadvajijñāsasva iti phalitārtha uktaḥ | abrūmahi ityantaṃ spaṣṭārtham | tattatpadānāṃ prayojanavattvaṃ pūrvānurodhe nānusandheyam ||
analyzed: prathama adhikaraṇa artham āha adhītaḥ iti janma ādi adhikaraṇa artham āha anantaḥ iti mahānanda eka kāraṇam iti iti tadvat jijñāsasva iti phalita arthaḥ uktaḥ abrūmahi ityantam spaṣṭa artham tat tad padānām prayojanavattvam pūrva anurodhe na anusandheyam

original: pādārthamāha - tadevam iti | atipatita iti kutarkāṇāṃ dharmigrāhakabādho'bhipretaḥ | cidacidvilakṣaṇakāraṇāstitvaṃ pādānugatārtha uktaḥ | ataḥ param iti | uktasya brahmakāraṇatvasyānyayogavyavacchedaḥ kriyate ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: pāda artham āha tat evam iti atipatitaḥ iti kutarkāṇām dharmi grāhaka bādhaḥ abhipretaḥ cit acit vilakṣaṇa kāraṇa astitvam pāda anugata arthaḥ uktaḥ atas param iti uktasya brahma kāraṇatvasya anya yoga vyavacchedaḥ kriyate iti arthaḥ

original: jīvādi iti | aspaṣṭa ityādikaṃ na brahmaliṅgagatamiti bhāvaḥ | tattat iti | tacchabdo liṅgiparaḥ | spaṣṭatarapūrvapakṣabījāni ityarthaḥ | dvitīyādye jīvaliṅgāvagamāt jīvādi ityuktiḥ | avayavisvārasyajīvaparatāya iti śaṅkāyā'vāntarasaṅgatiḥ | sarvatādātmyamanaḥprāṇasaṃbandhārbhakaukastvāṇutvādīni jīvaliṅgāni dṛśyante ||
analyzed: jīva ādi iti aspaṣṭaḥ iti ādikam na brahma liṅga gatam iti bhāvaḥ tat tat iti tad śabdaḥ liṅgi paraḥ spaṣṭatara pūrvapakṣa bījāni iti arthaḥ dvitīya ādye jīva liṅga avagamāt jīva ādi iti uktiḥ avayavi svārasya jīva paratāyai iti śaṅkāyāḥ avāntara saṅgatiḥ sarva tādātmya manaḥ prāṇa saṃbandha arbhaka oka tva aṇu tva ādīni jīva liṅgāni dṛśyante

original: sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt || 1-2-1 ||
analyzed: sarvatra prasiddha upadeśāt 121

original: idamāmnāyate chāndogye - atha khalu kratumayaḥ ... ... upasaṃhārasthabrahmapadamapi jīva eva pūjārthaṃ prayuktamityadhyavasīyate iti ||

original: sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | viṣayamāha - idam iti | prathamayojanāpekṣitamātramupāttam atha khalu ityādikam, na tu sarvam ityādi | bhārūpaḥ ityāde dvitīyasūtraviṣayatvāt bhārūpa ityantamupāttam | bhāṣyāntarānurodhena prathamayojanā | sarvaṃ khalu ityādeḥ paraviṣayatvaṃ sphuṭam | atha khalu ityādiviṣayamidaṃ sūtramanyairvyākhyātam ||
analyzed: sarvatra prasiddha upadeśāt viṣayam āha idam iti prathama yojana apekṣita mātram upāttam atha khalu ityādikam na tu sarvam ityādi bhārūpaḥ ityāde dvitīya sūtra viṣaya tvāt bhārūpaḥ iti antam upāttam bhāṣya antara anurodhena prathama yojanā sarvam khalu ityādeḥ para viṣaya tvam sphuṭam atha khalu ityādi viṣayam idam sūtram anyaiḥ vyākhyātam

original: pūrvavākyasya paraviṣayatvāt, taccheṣatvāduttaravākyānyapi tatheti na jīvaparatvaśaṅkā ityadhikaraṇamanāraṃbhaṇīyamityatrāha - atra iti | vidhyanta ropāsyaparatayā na pūrvaṇaikaviṣayateti jīvaparatvaśaṅkocitetyarthaḥ | pratipādita syopāsanasya iti | kratuśabdaḥ upāsanaparaḥ |

original: na tu prāgvihita brahmopāsanāṅgabhūtakarmaparaḥ, yathākratuḥ ityanena phalasaṃbandhadarśanāt | tatra ca kratuḥ upāstiḥ taṃ yathā yathopāsate ityetadaikārthyāt | prāk brahmopāsane vihite'pi jīvasya kratupracuratvāt, tadupāstyantaravidhiścopapanna iti bhāvaḥ | tatra ityādi spaṣṭam |
analyzed: na tu prāc vihita brahma upāsana aṅga bhūta karma paraḥ yathākratuḥ iti anena phala saṃbandha darśanāt tatra ca kratuḥ upāstiḥ tam yathā yathā upāsate iti etad aikārthyāt prāk brahma upāsane vihite api jīvasya kratu pracura tvāt tad upāsti antara vidhiḥ ca upapannaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tatra ityādi spaṣṭam

original: upakaraṇopakaraṇitvalakṣaṇasaṃbandha viśeṣasyāsphuṭatvāt aspaṣṭaliṅgatā ||
analyzed: upakaraṇa upakaraṇi tva lakṣaṇa saṃbandha viśeṣasya asphuṭa tvāt aspaṣṭa liṅga tā

original: prāk prakṛtaṃ brahmaiva kratuṃ kurvīta ityatropāsyatayā saṃbadhya manomayatvādiviśeṣyaṃ syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ, kiṃ brahmapadasya vidhipadākāṃkṣayā, uta kratuṃ kurvīta ityasyopāsyākāṃkṣayā vā brahmaśabdasyottaratrānvaya iti vikalpamabhipretya, prathamaṃ śiraḥ prativakti - na ca sarvam it | anyārtha tayā nirākāṃkṣatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: prāk prakṛtam brahma eva kratum kurvīta iti atra upāsyatayā saṃbadhya manaḥ maya tva ādi viśeṣyam syāt iti śaṅkāyām kim brahma padasya vidhi pada ākāṃkṣayā uta kratum kurvīta iti asya upāsya ākāṃkṣayā vā brahma śabdasya uttaratra anvayaḥ iti vikalpam abhipretya prathamam śiraḥ prativakti na ca sarvam tayā nirākāṃkṣa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: dvitīyaṃ prativakti - na ca sa kratum iti ananyārthena svavākyārthena nirākāṃkṣatvādityarthaḥ | vibhakti iti | prathamāntasyeva dvitīyāntasyāpyananvayaḥ, aṣaṣṭyantatvāviśeṣāt vipariṇāmastu sannihitānanyārthapadasyaivocita ityarthaḥ | ubhayākāṃkṣā - vidhipadamanomayādi padākāṃkṣā ||
analyzed: dvitīyam prativakti na ca sa kratum iti ananyārthena sva vākyārthena nirākāṃkṣa tvāt iti arthaḥ vibhakti iti prathamā antasya iva dvitīyā antasya api ananvayaḥ aṣaṣṭi anta tva aviśeṣāt vipariṇāmaḥ tu sannihita ananya artha padasya eva ucitaḥ iti arthaḥ ubhaya ākāṃkṣā vidhi pada manaḥ maya ādi pada ākāṃkṣā

original: evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ - sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | manomayatvādi guṇakaḥ ... ... manāyattaṃ jñānaṃ prāṇāyattāṃ sthatiṃ ca brahmaṇo niṣedhati ||
analyzed: evam prāpte brūmaḥ sarvatra prasiddha upadeśāt manaḥ maya tva ādi guṇakaḥ jñānam prāṇa āyattām sthatim ca brahmaṇaḥ niṣedhati

original: rāddhāntamāha - evam iti | sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt | sarvatra sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdavatsu iti bhāvaḥ | manomātreṇa saṃbandhamātraṃ darśitaṃ manomaya iti vākye ; hṛdā ityatra saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ | na cakṣuṣā ityatramanoviśeṣaṇa saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ| prāṇaśarīratvaṃ darśayati - tathā iti | prāṇaḥ - dhārakaḥ | dhārako hi śarīrī |
analyzed: rāddhāntam āha evam iti sarvatra prasiddha upadeśāt sarvatra sāmānya viśeṣa śabdavatsu iti bhāvaḥ manaḥ mātreṇa saṃbandha mātram darśitam manaḥ mayaḥ iti vākye hṛdā iti atra saṃbandha viśeṣaḥ na cakṣuṣā iti atra manaḥ viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha viśeṣaḥ prāṇa śarīra tvam darśayati tathā iti prāṇaḥ dhārakaḥ dhārakaḥ hi śarīrī

original: upasaṃhāravirodhamāha - evam iti | niṣedhāvirodhamāha - aprāṇa iti ||
analyzed: upasaṃhāra virodham āha evam iti niṣedha avirodham āha aprāṇaḥ iti

original: athavā - sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma jjalāniti ... ... anādya vidyayā devatiryaṅmanuṣyasthāvarātmanā'vatiṣṭhate iti |
analyzed: athavā sarvam khalu idam brahma anādya vidyayā deva tiryak manuṣya sthāvara ātmanā avatiṣṭhate iti

original: svāmimatayojanāmāha - athavā iti | adhyāhāryapratijñatvāt, ādyantagatabrahmaśabdadvayaviṣayaikyakhārasyavirodhāt, evaṃvicchāntaḥ iti śānteḥ śravaṇamanananiṣpādyatvadarśanāt, tadupāyopāstyāntarādarśanāt āśaṃsāryatvaṃ śāntaśabdāsvārasyāt, vṛttyananurodhācca prāgyojanā na varamiti bhāvaḥ | atraiva iti |

original: anantarasūtraśaṅkāmāha - satyaṃ jñānam iti | pariṇāmāt | pariṇāmāt ityukte tasya virodhihetutvameva ityāśaṅkyāha pariṇāmasvābhāvyāt iti | svabhāva eva hi virodhaheturityatrāha - nātra iti | kathamityapekṣāyām uktaṃ vivṛṇoti - evameva hi iti |

original: tattvakramasṛṣṭivat tadupayogiguṇavacca anuktaṃ sadvārakatvamanyato grāhyamiti darśayan pradhānaviṣayaśrutīnāṃ paraparyantatāmāha - aśeṣa iti | svaśarīratayā api iti eka śabdavyākhyānam | uktārthe mānamāha - tathaiva iti | āvaraṇatvāt tamaḥ anarthamūlatvāt mṛtyuḥ svarūpaikyavyāvṛttyarthamāha - avibhāga iti ||
analyzed: tattva krama sṛṣṭi vat tad upayogi guṇavat ca anuktam sat vāraka tvam anyatas grāhyam iti darśayan pradhāna viṣaya śrutīnām para paryanta tām āha aśeṣaḥ iti sva śarīra tayā api iti eka śabda vyākhyānam ukta arthe mānam āha tathā eva iti āvaraṇa tvāt tamaḥ anartha mūla tvāt mṛtyuḥ svarūpa aikya vyāvṛtti artham āha avibhāgaḥ iti

original: evaṃ svasmādvibhāgavyapadeśānarhatayā paramātmanā ... ... ato brahmaiva jagato nimittamupādānaṃ ca || 27 ||

original: udāhṛtaśrutisiddhamarthamāha - evaṃ svasmāt iti | tataḥ kiṃ prastutavirodhasya iti śaṅkāyām, avirodhena paścāt vyākhyātuṃ virodhasphorakametatprakaraṇasthavākyamādatte - satyaṃ jñānam iti | vyākhyeyapadāni vyācaṣṭe atra iti | tapa ālocane iti dhātuḥ ||

original: śrutyantarānugṛhīte tatprakaraṇavākyānāmarthamāha - tadayamartha iti | udāhṛtavākyeṣu ghaṭakavākyasyārthamāha - tadeva iti | kathaṃ virodhaḥ parihṛta ityatrāha - evam iti | kāryatvadoṣāsaṅkaraṃ cāha - paramātmani ityādinā | avāptakāmalīlāsṛṣṭau mānamāha - sarvāṇi iti | pūrvapakṣyupāttaśrutyarthamāha - asmāt iti spaṣṭam |

original: idaṃ sūtraṃ mṛṣāvādināṃ viruddham | bhedābhedapakṣe'pi bhogyāṃśena pariṇāmaḥ | asmanmate tu viśeṣaṇāṃśena iti asvārasyaṃ tulyam | śrutyantaropapattyānuguṇyaṃ tvadhikamiti vaiṣamyam || 27 ||

analyzed: jīva ajñāna pakṣam dūṣayati tat etat iti kim jīvasya akalpita svarūpeṇa avidyā āśraya tvam uta kalpita ākāreṇa atha kalpita ākāra viśiṣṭa svarūpeṇa iti vikalpam abhipretya prathamam śiraḥ dūṣayati jīvasya iti dvitīyam dūṣayati tad atiriktena iti jīvaḥ hi avidyā āśrayaḥ tat katham jaḍasya tad āśraya tvam iti atra āha na khalu iti

original: tṛtīyaṃ śaṅkate - kalpita iti | dūṣayati - tanna iti | kuta ityatrāha - svarūpasya iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - avidyāśrayākāra iti | avidyāśrayatve sati viśiṣṭatvaṃ viśiṣṭākāra eva avidyāśraya ityātmāśrayaṇamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tṛtīyam śaṅkate kalpitaḥ iti dūṣayati tat naḥ iti kutas iti atra āha svarūpasya iti tatas kim iti atra āha avidyā āśraya ākāraḥ iti avidyā āśraya tve sati viśiṣṭa tvam viśiṣṭa ākāraḥ eva avidyā āśrayaḥ iti ātma āśrayaṇam iti arthaḥ

original: avidyāyā ekatve dūṣaṇamāha - tatraikasmin iti | bahutvaṃ śaṅkate prati iti| bhantsyate - baddho bhaviṣyati | dūṣayati - tanna iti | advaitahāniprasaṅgāt svābhāvikatvānabhyupagamaḥ | kimasyāḥ iti | jīvabhedakalpakā'vidyā tatklapteḥ prāgeva nāśrayituṃ kṣamā, jīvāsiddherityarthaḥ | bījāṅkureṣu iti |
analyzed: avidyāyāḥ ekatve dūṣaṇam āha tatra ekasmin iti bahutvam śaṅkate prati iti baddhaḥ bhaviṣyati dūṣayati tat naḥ iti advaita hāni prasaṅgāt svābhāvika tva anabhyupagamaḥ kim asyāḥ iti jīva bheda kalpaka avidyā tad klapteḥ prāk eva na āśrayitum kṣamā jīva asiddheḥ iti arthaḥ bīja aṅkureṣu iti

original: tatra notpādakasya utpādakatayotpādyāpekṣeti bhidā | aśakanīyatā - sādhayitumaśakyatā | kṛtanāśādi iti | ādi śabdāt jīvanityatvādiśrutivirodha uktaḥ ||
analyzed: tatra na utpādakasya utpādaka tayā utpādya apekṣā iti bhidā aśakanīya tā sādhayitum aśakya tā kṛta nāśa ādi iti ādi śabdāt jīva nitya tva ādi śruti virodhaḥ uktaḥ

original: jīvākhyadharmiklṛpteḥ pravāhānāditve kathitaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ jīvatvadharmaklṛptipravāhānāditve'pyatidiśati - ata eva iti | dharmaklṛptipakṣasya nirastatāṃ vivṛṇoti - avidyāpravāhe iti | pakṣadvaye'pi dūṣaṇamekamāha āmokṣāt iti | jīvasya - jīvabhāvaviśiṣṭasya ||
analyzed: jīva ākhya dharmi klṛpteḥ pravāha anādi tve kathitam dūṣaṇam jīvatva dharma klṛpti pravāha anādi tve pi atidiśati atas eva iti dharma klṛpti pakṣasya nirasta tām vivṛṇoti avidyā pravāhe iti pakṣa dvaye api dūṣaṇam ekam āha ā mokṣāt iti jīvasya jīva bhāva viśiṣṭasya

original: durghaṭatvena parihāraṃ dūṣayati - yaccoktam iti | śuddhavidyāsvarūpatvāt - śuddhajñaptirūpatvāt | uktābhiḥ - anyonyāśrayādibhiḥ | anirmokṣaḥ āvidyajīvāvasthiterityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: durghaṭa tvena parihāram dūṣayati yat ca uktam iti śuddhavidyā svarūpa tvāt śuddhajñapti rūpa tvāt uktābhiḥ anyonya āśraya ādibhiḥ anirmokṣaḥ āvidya jīva avasthiteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: dārṣṭāntikālocanayā dūṣitam | atha dṛṣṭāntālocanayā dūṣayati yaccoktam iti | doṣapratibhāsānupapattyā dūṣayati - kiṃ ca iti | anyasya iti śirodṛṣṭāntānurodhāduktam ||
analyzed: dārṣṭāntika ālocanayā dūṣitam atha dṛṣṭānta ālocanayā dūṣayati yat ca uktam iti doṣa pratibhāsa anupapattyā dūṣayati kim ca iti anyasya iti śiraḥ dṛṣṭānta anurodhāt uktam

original: avidyākāryabhramāśrayanirūpaṇayā dūṣayati - kiṃ ca iti | kaḥ kalpakaḥ ko bhramāśrayaḥ | ātmāśraya iti | jīvasiddheḥ svaviṣayabhramāśrayasvasiddhisāpekṣatvāt ātmāśrayaḥ ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: avidyā kārya bhrama āśraya nirūpaṇayā dūṣayati kim ca iti kaḥ kalpakaḥ kaḥ bhrama āśrayaḥ ātma āśrayaḥ iti jīva siddheḥ sva viṣaya bhrama āśraya sva siddhi sāpekṣa tvāt ātma āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ ca brahmājñānānabhyupagame, kiṃ brahma ... ... paramārthato brahmavyatiriktābhāvāt tadananyatvaṃ jagataḥ iti ||
analyzed: kim ca brahma ajñāna anabhyupagame kim brahma paramārthataḥ brahma vyatirikta abhāvāt tad ananyatvam jagataḥ iti

original: kiṃ ca iti | sphuṭam | ata eva - īkṣāpūrvakasṛṣṭyarthamasya jīvadarśanārthaṃ cāvidyānvayasya upagamādityarthaḥ| māyā - parabhramahetuḥ; svabhramahetuḥ avidyā iti tanmatam | jīvadārśitvam - aparamārthajīvadarśitvam | paramohanahetureva mohanīyadarśanaheturiti śaṅkate - atha iti | tarhi ityādi | sphuṭam |
analyzed: kim ca iti sphuṭam atas eva īkṣā pūrvaka sṛṣṭi artham asya jīva darśana artham ca avidyā anvayasya upagamāt iti arthaḥ māyā para bhrama hetuḥ sva bhrama hetuḥ avidyā iti tad matam jīvadārśi tvam aparamārtha jīva darśi tvam para mohana hetuḥ eva mohanīya darśana hetuḥ iti śaṅkate atha iti tarhi ityādi sphuṭam

original: apumarthadṛṣṭihetutvābhāvānugamenāpi dūṣayati – tannirasane ca iti | duḥkhahetutve'pi avastubhāsanameva apumarthaḥ nirasanīyatvāt ato māyāyāśca taddhetutvādavidyātvamiti bhāvaḥ | avidyāmantareṇa nopapadyate iti | mṛṣātvāditi bhāvaḥ | nityayā - apumarthābhāvenānirasanīyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| āśrayavibhāgānupapattyā ca dūṣayati - māyāśrayatayā iti ||
analyzed: apumartha dṛṣṭi hetutva abhāva anugamena api dūṣayati tad nirasane ca iti duḥkha hetutve pi avastu bhāsanam eva apumarthaḥ nirasanīya tvāt atas māyāyāḥ ca tad hetutvāt avidyā tvam iti bhāvaḥ avidyām antareṇa na upapadyate iti mṛṣātvāt iti bhāvaḥ nityayā apumartha abhāvena anirasanīya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ āśraya vibhāga anupapattyā ca dūṣayati māyā āśraya tayā iti

original: yat tu ityādi | ata eva - āśrayaikatve'pi sarvavyavasthopapādakahetunā kālpanikatvena | kāryapāramārthye eva kāraṇabahutvam, na tvapāramārthya ityāha - paramārthikī iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - apāramārthikī tu iti ||
analyzed: yat tu ityādi atas eva āśraya ekatve api sarva vyavasthā upapādaka hetunā kālpanika tvena kārya pāramārthye eva kāraṇa bahutvam na tu apāramārthye iti āha paramārthikī iti tatas kim iti atra āha apāramārthikī tu iti

original: prayogaśca iti | ādyau jīvājñānavādinaṃ prati kathitau | antyau dvau taṃ bhedavādinaṃ ca prati | jaḍatvādayaḥ ekaikamanapekṣāḥ| bhinnatve ca iti vyatirekitrayam | abhinnatvaṃ sādhyam | vastuparicchedāt paricchedāntaradvayaṃ prasañjayati - vastutaḥ paricchinnasya ityādinā | tataḥkimityatrāha evaṃ ca iti | utpatti iti |
analyzed: prayogaḥ ca iti ādyau jīva ajñāna vādinam prati kathitau antyau dvau tam bheda vādinam ca prati jaḍa tva ādayaḥ ekaikam anapekṣāḥ bhinna tve ca iti vyatireki trayam abhinna tvam sādhyam vastu paricchedāt pariccheda antara dvayam prasañjayati vastutas paricchinnasya ityādinā tatas kim iti atra āha evam ca iti utpatti iti

original: avikāraśrutivirodhaścetyarthaḥ| ekāvidyayā sarvavyavasthopapattimupasaṃharati - ataḥ iti | brahmājñānavādapakṣamupasaṃharati tasmāt iti | ananyatvaṃ jagataḥ iti | paramārthabhūtānyatvaṃ na bhavati ityarthaḥ| abhāvaḥ nañarthaḥ ||
analyzed: avikāra śruti virodhaḥ ca iti arthaḥ eka avidyayā sarva vyavasthā upapattim upasaṃharati atas iti brahma ajñāna vāda pakṣam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti ananyatvam jagataḥ iti paramārtha bhūta anyatvam na bhavati iti arthaḥ abhāvaḥ nañ arthaḥ

original: atrocyate - nirviśeṣasvaprakāśamātraṃ brahma .... ... ahaṃtvamādyarthavilakṣaṇaṃ cinmātraṃ hyātmā tvanmate ||
analyzed: atrā ucyate nirviśeṣa sva prakāśa mātram brahma ahaṃtvam ādi artha vilakṣaṇam cit mātram hi ātmā tvad mate

original: brahmājñānavādinaṃ vaiśeṣikaḥ prativadati - atrocyate iti | niraṃśasya iti | tirodhāne'pi jaḍāṃśaḥ sthitaḥ iti durvacamiti bhāvaḥ | svavacanaviruddham - nityatvādisādhakavacanaviruddham | uktam - asmin prabandhe siddhāntinā ityarthaḥ | mithyātvānityatvabhedamāha - yaddeśa iti | anityatve sādhye siddhasādhyatā;
analyzed: brahma ajñāna vādinam vaiśeṣikaḥ prativadati atra ucyate iti niraṃśasya iti tirodhāne api jaḍa aṃśaḥ sthitaḥ iti durvacam iti bhāvaḥ sva vacana viruddham nitya tva ādi sādhaka vacana viruddham uktam asmin prabandhe siddhāntinā iti arthaḥ mithyātva anitya tva bhedam āha yad deśe iti anitya tve sādhye siddha sādhyatā

original: mithyātve tu sopādhikatvavyāghātabādhitatvānaikāntyādīni iti bhāvaḥ | deśakālādi iti | ādi śabdāt kriyādi | deśakālabhrameṣu deśakālāntararūpopādhyabhāvāt sādhyasamavyāptirneti na vācyam | tatrāpi kriyāderupādhitvāditi bhāvaḥ | bādhārhatvaṃ sādhyam; bādhitatvaṃ liṅgamiti na sādhyāviśiṣṭatā | dāhārhatvadāhakāryatvavat | samavahitāt - samanvitāt |
analyzed: mithyātve tu sopādhikatva vyāghāta bādhita tva anaikāntya ādīni iti bhāvaḥ deśa kāla ādi iti ādi śabdāt kriyā ādi deśa kāla bhrameṣu deśa kāla antara rūpa upādhi abhāvāt sādhyasama vyāptiḥ na iti na vācyam tatra api kriyā ādeḥ upādhi tvāt iti bhāvaḥ bādhā arha tvam sādhyam bādhita tvam liṅgam iti na sādhya aviśiṣṭa tā dāha arha tva dāha kārya tva vat samavahitāt samanvitāt

original: kāraṇāntaram - adṛṣṭeśvarasaṅkalpādi | etadāyattatvābhāvāt - vastumātrānāyattatvāt avikṛtatvadharmitayā taddhi prakṛtam ||
analyzed: kāraṇa antaram adṛṣṭa īśvara saṅkalpa ādi etad āyattatva abhāvāt vastu mātra anāyattatvāt avikṛta tva dharmitayā tat hi prakṛtam

original: anugrāhyamāha - kāraṇasya ca iti | paroktatarko jātyuktiḥ | kāryakāraṇatvabhaṅgavācisvavacanasya pramitijanakatvopagamāt | na cet sutarāṃ na kāryakāraṇatvabhaṅgaḥ | yathoktaparikaraḥ - deśakālādiḥ | hemapratyabhijñākathamityatrāha - prāk iti | yaccānyat iti | ādi śabdāt virodhe'piśāstrabalīyastvam ||
analyzed: anugrāhyam āha kāraṇasya ca iti para ukta tarkaḥ jāti uktiḥ kārya kāraṇatva bhaṅga vāci sva vacanasya pramiti janaka tva upagamāt na ced sutarām na kārya kāraṇatva bhaṅgaḥ yathā ukta parikaraḥ deśa kāla ādiḥ hema pratyabhijñā katham iti atra āha prāk iti yat ca anyat iti ādi śabdāt virodha īpi śāstra balīyaḥ tvam

original: yaccoktam ityādi | dehabhedādapratisandhirityatrāha - saubhari iti | antaḥ karaṇabhedādityatrāha - na ca iti | ekaśarīravartyātmana ekatve siddhasādhyatā | anekaśarīravartināṃ cet dharmigrāhakabādha ityarthaḥ | sarvaśarīrāṇāmavidyākalpitatvābhāvāt iti | sapakṣabhūtadehasyāpi avidyākalpitatvābhāvāt dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyamityabhipretam ||
analyzed: yat ca uktam ityādi deha bhedāt apratisandhiḥ iti atra āha saubhari iti antar karaṇa bhedāt iti atra āha na ca iti eka śarīra varti ātmanaḥ ekatve siddhasādhyatā aneka śarīra vartinām ced dharmi grāhaka bādhaḥ iti arthaḥ sarva śarīrāṇām avidyā kalpita tva abhāvāt iti sapakṣa bhūta dehasya api avidyā kalpita tva abhāvāt dṛṣṭāntasya sādhya vaikalyam iti abhipretam

original: yacca cetanāt ityādinā ahameva sarvaṃ cetanajātaṃ cetanatvāt itīdamarthato'nūditam | kālātyāpadeśena dūṣayati -- tadapi iti | uktidūṣaṇamāha - yat tu iti ||
analyzed: yat ca cetanāt ityādinā aham eva sarvam cetana jātam cetana tvāt iti idam arthataḥ nūditam kāla atya apadeśena dūṣayati tat api iti ukti dūṣaṇam āha yat tu iti

original: kiṃ ca nirviśeṣacinmātrātireki sarvaṃ mithyeti vadato mokṣārthaśravaṇādiprayatno niṣphalaḥ ... ... bhedavādinastu sarvacidaciddastuśarīratvena brahmaṇaḥ sarvaprakāratvāt svataḥ parato'pi paricchedo na vidyate ||
analyzed: kim ca nirviśeṣa cit mātra atireki sarvam mithyā iti vadataḥ mokṣa artha śravaṇa ādi prayatnaḥ niṣphalaḥ bheda vādinaḥ tu sarva cit acit dastu śarīra tvena brahmaṇaḥ sarva prakāra tvāt svatas paratas api paricchedaḥ na vidyate

original: pratitarkānāha - kiṃ ca iti | avidyākāryatvādau niṣphalatvādiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | karmahetukatvāt tadvadeva tvanmate'pi niṣphalatvāditi cet, na, śrutestulyadoṣatvābhāvena tadbādhena parihārasya suvacatvāditi bhāvaḥ | sa ca vyaktībhaviṣyati ||
analyzed: pratitarkān āha kim ca iti avidyā kāryatva ādau niṣphalatva ādi prasaṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ karma hetuka tvāt tadvat eva tvad mate pi niṣphalatvāt iti ced na śruteḥ tulya doṣatva abhāvena tad bādhena parihārasya suvacatvāt iti bhāvaḥ sa ca vyaktībhaviṣyati

original: dvidhā mṛṣāvādināṃ gatiḥ | brahma svarūpaparavākyapratipādyamiti, brahma tu na pratipādyaṃ bhedaniṣedhaparā vedāntāḥ iti ca | tatra pratipādyatvapakṣe'niṣṭaṃ prasañjayati - kiṃ ca nirviśeṣa iti | anumānaiḥ - tarkaiḥ | ūhastarko'numānoktiḥ iti prasiddheḥ | nirastān iti | svābhimatārthasādhakatvaṃ nirastamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dvidhā mṛṣāvādinām gatiḥ brahma svarūpa para vākya pratipādyam iti brahma tu na pratipādyam bheda niṣedha parāḥ vedāntāḥ iti ca tatra pratipādya tva pakṣe niṣṭam prasañjayati kim ca nirviśeṣaḥ iti anumānaiḥ tarkaiḥ ūhaḥ tarkaḥ anumāna uktiḥ iti prasiddheḥ nirastān iti sva abhimata artha sādhaka tvam nirastam iti arthaḥ

original: atādṛśasya - karmakartṛrahitasya | tādṛśasya iti pāṭhe sakartṛkarmaṇastasya nirviśeṣatve'bhimate sā na sidhyatīti ||
analyzed: atādṛśasya karma kartṛ rahitasya tādṛśasya iti pāṭhe sa kartṛ karmaṇaḥ tasya nirviśeṣa tva ibhimate sā na sidhyati iti

original: pūrvamavidyāhetoḥ naiṣphalyamuktam | tanna; asatyāt satyotpatteḥ ityatrāha - yaḥ punaḥ iti | paramate tadasiddhimāha - so'pi iti | svamate tadasiddhimāha - asmābhirapi iti ||
analyzed: pūrvam avidyā hetoḥ naiṣphalyam uktam tat na asatyāt satya utpatteḥ iti atra āha yaḥ punar iti para mate tad asiddhim āha saḥ api iti sva mate tad asiddhim āha asmābhiḥ api iti

original: bādhādṛṣṭimupagamya dūṣayati - duṣṭakāraṇa iti | sā ca netyāha - kiṃ ca iti | mādhyamikavaco doṣamūlamityatrāha - doṣamūlatvaṃ tu iti | ataḥ ... na setsyati ityanvayaḥ | asiddhimupapādayati - loka iti | tataḥ kimityatrāha - nirviśeṣa iti | jñātṛtvasaviśeṣatvayorabhāvāt āśrayatayā karaṇatayā ca na pratibhāsādihetutvamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: bādhā dṛṣṭim upagamya dūṣayati duṣṭa kāraṇaḥ iti sā ca na iti āha kim ca iti mādhyamika vacaḥ doṣa mūlam iti atra āha doṣa mūla tvam tu iti atas na setsyati iti anvayaḥ asiddhim upapādayati lokaḥ iti tatas kim iti atra āha nirviśeṣaḥ iti jñātṛ tva saviśeṣa tvayoḥ abhāvāt āśraya tayā karaṇatayā ca na pratibhāsa ādi hetutvam iti arthaḥ

original: ādi śabdāt vyavahāraḥ ||
analyzed: ādi śabdāt vyavahāraḥ

original: na kaścidviśeṣo'nyatra tatsaṃraṃbhāt iti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ - adhiṣṭhānasya mithyātve'dhiṣṭhānāntarāpekṣayā anavasthā doṣamṛṣātve'pi tulyā | svarūpapravāhānāditvābhyāṃ daurghaṭyasvaparanirvāhakābhyāṃ ca parihṛtiśca tathā | upapattyanapekṣatve cātiprasaṅgāḥ prāk darśitāḥ | doṣasatyatvāpekṣā cāparamārthatvaprayuktopapattirūpeti ||

original: yattu ityādi | ānantyaṃ - sāvadhisaṃkhyārāhityam | svarūpānantyāt - deśakālādyupādhirahitasvarūpānantyāt | deśakālādi iti ādi śabdāt kartrādi | kartrādinā'pyavacchedadarśanāt gṛhādyavacchinnātmapakṣīkāre siddhasādhyatā | avacchinnaghaṭeṣu sapakṣīkṛteṣu bhinnatvaṃ sopādhikam | anyathā dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavaikalyam ||

original: ananyatvam aikyam | virodho nañarthaḥ | pratijñādṛṣṭāntavākyadvayaṃ prakṛtyadhikaraṇaviṣayaḥ | vaiśeṣikanirāsena kāryakāraṇaikyopapādakatvādasya vākyasya etadadhikaraṇaviṣayatvamityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ tadupapādayadbhyaḥ iti | aikapadyavyudāsāya vācādibhyaḥ ityanuktiḥ | ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣavyudāsāyāha ārambhaṇaśabda iti ||

original: udāhṛtavākyānāṃ tadananyaparatvamupapādayati - tathā hi iti | dṛṣṭāntavākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe - yathaika iti | vācā ityādivākyasya tadupapādakatvamāha - atra iti | nāmno mṛdārabdhatvābhāvāt sparśārthatayā vyākhyātam | ghaṭena iti vācā ityajahallakṣaṇetyarthaḥ | siddhaye iti prayojanatayā hetutvamityarthaḥ | teneva - pūrvavākyaprastutena |

original: sparśaśabdārthaṃ vivṛṇvan uktaṃ saṃgraheṇāha udaka iti | buddhyādibhedaḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ āste śete ityādau buddhibhedādavasthābhedācca dṛṣṭaḥ | atra tvavasthābhedanibandhanatve kiṃ niyāmakamityatrāha - ataḥ iti | evakārārthamāha - na tu iti | sāmānyena buddhyādibhedānāmanyathāsiddhimāha - ataḥ iti |

original: dehakṣaṇikatve'pi bālādiśabdānāṃ cetanaparyantatvānna sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasya, dehasyābādhitapratyabhijñāviṣayatvācca |

original: bhāvābhāvavirodhaṃ pariharati - yaduktam iti | kāryabhedaṃ parivakti - tattat iti | kārakavyāpāravaiyarthyaṃ vyudasyati - saṃsthānayoga iti | bhūtapratyayanirdeśaḥ prathamakṣaṇāpekṣayeti yogaśabdasya bhāvaḥ | ato notpadyate iti vyāhāraḥ nātra śakttyu tpannavyāhārābhāvaśca | tata eva kapālatve sati ghaṭasya niṣṭhatvoktiśca evaṃ yuktā |
analyzed: bhāva abhāva virodham pariharati yat uktam iti kārya bhedam parivakti tat tat iti kāraka vyāpāra vaiyarthyam vyudasyati saṃsthāna yogaḥ iti bhūta pratyaya nirdeśaḥ prathama kṣaṇa apekṣayā iti yoga śabdasya bhāvaḥ atas na utpadyate iti vyāhāraḥ na atra śaktti u tpanna vyāhāra abhāvaḥ ca tatas eva kapāla tve sati ghaṭasya niṣṭha tva uktiḥ ca evam yuktā

original: saṃsthānasya ityādinopanyastacodyaṃ pratibandīmukhena pariharati - asatkāryavādino'pi iti | yathotpatterutpatticodanaṃ nityasamajātyuktiḥ tathā'vasthāyā utpattimukhena codyamapi; avasthāviśeṣasya cotpattirūpatvādityarthaḥ | asmākaṃ tu iti | pṛthaksthitipratītikāryānarhāṇāṃ na pṛthagutpattyādyapekṣā yathotpatteḥ ,

original: tādātmyasya vyāptihetukatvajñāpanāyodāhṛtavākyaṃ vivṛṇoti - tisraḥ iti | kṛtsnam tisra iti nyūnatāṃ vyāvartayati | na tu mānāntarasiddhamadhikamiti bhāvaḥ | acidvastu - idaṃśabdasamānādhikaraṇa devatā śabdo lakṣaṇayā'dhiṣṭheyācitpara iti bhāvaḥ | vastuśabdo 'citpāramārthyasūcakaḥ | tatpāramārthyaṃ tu asṛjata iti sṛjyatvokteḥ ||

original: svātmaka iti | anena jīvenātmanā iti ātma śabdaḥ svavācīti bhāvaḥ | nāmarūpe kasyetyatrāha - etat iti | sannihitameva nāmarūpabhāgiti bhāvaḥ | vicitra iti | devādivyaṣṭināmarūpe ityarthaḥ | anena tejaḥśabdatejastvaprabhṛtisamaṣṭināmarūpavyāvṛttiḥ | samaṣṭināmarūpe hi prāgeva vyākṛte |

original: jīvaparayoḥ svarūpaikyavyudāsāya svātmakatvaṃ vivṛṇoti - svātmanaḥ iti | sihena mayā itivadityarthaḥ ||
